element.name: 1cPrereqs
element.definition: The element <1cPrereqs> describes required knowledge, credits and experience a student must have to take a course.
element.title: Prerequisites

element.name: accessDoorOrPanel
element.definition: The element <accessDoorOrPanel> contains information about doors or panels to be opened for getting access to the equipment.
element.title: Access door or panel

element.name: accessFrom
element.definition: This element allows specifying the zone(s) and/or access point(s) from which the functional item can be reached .
element.title: Accesses to the functional item

element.name: accessory
element.definition: The element <accessory> is contained in the list of accessories element <accessoryGroup>. The list of accessories is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
element.title: Accessory

element.name: accessoryGroup
element.definition: The list of acessories <accessoryGroup> contains the accessories.
element.title: List of accessories

element.name: accessPointAlt
element.definition: This element contains the properties of the access point that depend on the Product configuration. Thus this element contains applicability.
element.title: Alternate access points

element.name: accessPointIdent
element.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, this element identifies semantically the access point with regard to its attributes.
element.title: Access point identifier

element.name: accessPointRef
element.definition: The element <accessPointRef> is used to store the access point’s identification where an item is located. It is used in accordance with the rules in Chap 3.4.
element.title: Access point

element.name: accessPointRefGroup
element.definition: The element <accessPointRef> is used to store the access point’s identification where an item is located. It is used in accordance with the rules in Chap 3.4.
element.title: References to other access points

element.name: accessPointRepository
element.definition: This element is used to provide a list of access points and their associated properties.
element.title: Access point repository

element.name: accessPointSpec
element.definition: This element represents one access point. It contains its associated properties.
element.title: Access point specification

element.name: accessPointType
element.definition: This element is used to specify, through its attribute, whether the access point is a panel, a door, an electrical panel or any other type of access point.
element.title: Access point type

element.name: accessTo
element.definition: This element allows listing items that can be reached from the access point. Those items can be functional items or other items.
element.title: Items reachable from the access point

element.name: acronym
element.definition: The element <acronymTerm> contains the acronym itself and the definition of the acronym when that acronym is first used.
element.title: Acronym

element.name: acronymDefinition
element.definition: The element <acronymDefinition> contains the definition of the acronym when that acronym is first used.
element.title: Acronym definition

element.name: acronymTerm
element.definition: The element <acronymTerm> contains the acronym itself and a reference to its definition.
element.title: Acronym term

element.name: action
element.definition: The element <action> contains an action in the isolation procedure.
element.title: Action

element.name: additionalModification
element.definition: The element <additionalModification> contains an indication that a modification is additionally covered.
element.title: Additional modification

element.name: address
element.definition: The postal address from where the comment/response is sent.
element.title: Address

element.name: altIdent
element.definition: The alternative identification element <altIdent> is used for additional identification of a harness. An alternative identification can contain a manufacturer part number and the related manufacturer code.
element.title: Alternative identification

element.name: altIdentGroup
element.definition: The list of alternative identifications element <altIdentGroup> is used as a container for the subordinate alternative identification elements.
element.title: Alternative identifications

element.name: altPart
element.definition: This element provides one or several alternate part(s), ie parts that can be used on condition that a modification has been performed. The description of the modification can be provided.
element.title: Alternate parts

element.name: altPartDescr
element.definition: This element is used to describe the modification to be performed on one alternate part.
element.title: Alternate part modification

element.name: amperage
element.definition: The element <amperage> contains the amperage information of the wire material.
element.title: Amperage

element.name: answer
element.definition: This element can be used to insert comments on the data module requirement list entry.
element.title: Data module requirement answer

element.name: applic
element.definition: The element <applic> is populated by the technical author or generated by the production system during initial authoring and updating activity of the data module.
element.title: Applicability model

element.name: applicabilitySegment
element.definition: The element <applicabilitySegment> is used to identify an S2000M Applicability Segment (CCS).
element.title: CCS data

element.name: applicCrossRefTableRef
element.definition: The element <applicCrossRefTableRef> contains a pointer to the Applicability Cross-reference Table (ACT) data module that applies to the data module/ publication module.
element.title: Applicability cross-reference table reference

element.name: assert
element.definition: The element <assert> provides for a single test for the computable branch of the applicability annotation. The assert annotation specifies the product attribute or condition to test and a set of values and/or ranges to test against. The result of evaluating an assert annotation will be a Boolean value of 'true' or 'false'.
element.title: Single applicability test - assert

element.name: assertion
element.definition: The element <assertion> assigns a value to a variable.
element.title: Assertion

element.name: assign
element.definition: The element <assign> associates a value with a product attribute or condition. It contains the following attributes:
element.title: Assign

element.name: assocWarningMalfunction
element.definition: The associated fault (warning or malfunction) which is part of the current correlated fault.
element.title: Associated warning or malfunction

element.name: assy
element.definition: The equipment assembly information element <assy> contains subordinate assembly information for the equipment in coded form and references to detailed assembly instructions.
element.title: Assembly information

element.name: assyInstruction
element.definition: The element <assyInstruction> is used as a container for the subordinate accessory assembly information. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.9.5.
element.title: Assembly instructions

element.name: attachmentRef
element.definition: The file name consists of the prefix "COM", the comment identification code, a sequential number for the attachment in this comment (MM) and the file type extension (eg .PDF, .ZIP, .XLS).
element.title: Reference to an attachment

element.name: attachStoreShipPart
element.definition: The element <attachStoreShipPart> is used to indicate if an item is an attaching, storage or shipping part using the attribute
element.title: Attaching storage or shipping part

element.name: attentionListItemPara
element.definition: The element <attentionListItemPara> contains the list items paragraphs when one or more list item paragraphs are needed.
element.title: Attention list item para

element.name: attentionRandomList
element.definition: The element <attentionRandomList> contains the list items.
element.title: Attention random list

element.name: attentionRandomListItem
element.definition: The element <attentionRandomListItem> contains one list item for attention random lists.
element.title: Attention random list item

element.name: attentionSequentialList
element.definition: The element <attentionSequentialList> contains an attention sequential (ordered) list in a note. This element mirrors the element <sequentialList> with the exception that the following content is not available:
element.title: Attention sequential list

element.name: attentionSequentialListItem
element.definition: The element <attentionSequentialListItem> contains list items and can consist of one or more paragraphs.
element.title: Attention sequential list item

element.name: attenuation
element.definition: The element <attenuation> contains the attenuation information of wire material.
element.title: Attenuation

element.name: authorityExceptions
element.definition: The element <authorityExceptions> contains deviations of the data module content from the standard given in the authority block for configurations.
element.title: Authority exceptions

element.name: authorityInfo
element.definition: The element <authorityInfo> contains the authority that owns the source data from which the data module is written. The codes to be used in this element are to be determined by the project.
element.title: Authority information

element.name: authorityInfoAndTp
element.definition: The element <authorityInfoAndTp> contains both the authority block information and the technical publications baseline when it is appropriate to use both.
element.title: Authority block and technical publications information

element.name: authorityNotes
element.definition: The element <authorityNotes> contains additional information that can be necessary to explain preceding entries. Whenever a data module is only applicable to one or a range of serial numbers, this is stated here. It is recommended that, where applicable, the titles of documents be given under authority exceptions. The notes are also be used for recording deficiency reports, special technical orders, service bulletins, explanations of excluded and additional modifications, and similar documents.
element.title: Authority notes

element.name: basicCorrelatedFaults
element.definition: The element <basicCorrelatedFaults> contains the list of basic faults (messages and/or warnings) that have been correlated.
element.title: Messages and warnings

element.name: behavior
element.definition: The element <behavior> specifies how the link operates, when a reference is supposed to be realized as a link.
element.title: Link behavior information

element.name: bitMessage
element.definition: The basic fault (computerized message or warning/malfunction) which is part of the current correlated fault.
element.title: Computerized message from built-in test equipment

element.name: blockGroupingValue
element.definition: The element <blockGroupingValue> contains the block information of terminal modules. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.9.2.
element.title: Block grouping information

element.name: boundary
element.definition: This element describes a boundary. A boundary can be expressed textually or with specific measures (rib, frame...)
element.title: A boundary

element.name: boundaryFrom
element.definition: These elements are used to define the boundaries of a zone, respectively the start and the end boundaries.
element.title: Zone boundaries

element.name: boundaryTo
element.definition: These elements are used to define the boundaries of a zone, respectively the start and the end boundaries.
element.title: Zone boundaries

element.name: brex
element.definition: The element <brex> contains all business rules specified by a BREX data module.
element.title: Exchange business rules

element.name: brexDmRef
element.definition: The element <brexDmRef> contains a pointer to the business rules data module (BREX data module) that applies to the data module. For a detailed description of the BREX module and related aspects, refer to Chap 4.10.
element.title: Business rules reference

element.name: building
element.definition: The element <building> contains the building number where the business is located.
element.title: Building identifier

element.name: businessUnit
element.definition: The element <businessUnit> contains information about the business, including name, address, and contacts.
element.title: Business unit

element.name: businessUnitAddress
element.definition: The element <businessUnitAddress> contains the information required to contact the business unit.
element.title: Business unit address

element.name: businessUnitName
element.definition: The element <businessUnitName> contains a string identifying the name of the business unit.
element.title: Business unit name

element.name: buyerFurnishedEquipFlag
element.definition: This element is used as a flag to specify whether the customer furnishes the part or not. As this value depends on the customer, the attribute applicRefId and the referenced element <applic>, both must be populated in accordance with Chap 3.9.5.3.
element.title: Buyer furnished equipment flag

element.name: calibrationMarker
element.definition: The element <calibrationMarker> is used to identify items that require calibration. This element should be set to "1" if an item requires calibration.
element.title: Calibration marker

element.name: caption
element.definition: This element <caption> represents a single illuminated warning light, push button, annunciator, or display caption. It can be used inline within text content elements such as <para>, or grouped within the element <captionGroup> structure as given in Para 2.
element.title: Captions

element.name: captionBody
element.definition: The element <captionBody> is equivalent to a CALS table element <tbody>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.6.
element.title: Caption body

element.name: captionEntry
element.definition: The element <captionEntry> represents the table cells that contain the captions or caption text; it is equivalent to a CALS table element <entry>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.6.
element.title: Caption entry

element.name: captionGroup
element.definition: The element <captionGroup> is equivalent to a CALS table element <table>. It is used to represent blocks of illuminated warning lights, push buttons, annunciators, or display captions.
element.title: Caption group

element.name: captionLine
element.definition: This element represents a single line of text, so its text content should not wrap to second or subsequent lines.
element.title: Caption line

element.name: captionRow
element.definition: The element <captionRow> represents a caption table row and is equivalent to a CALS table element <row>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.6.
element.title: Caption row

element.name: captionText
element.definition: The element <captionText> allows text to be added to a <captionGroup>.
element.title: Caption text

element.name: case
element.definition: The element <case> is used to identify a case as part of a list of possible cases.
element.title: Case statement

element.name: caseCond
element.definition: The element <caseCond> is used to identify a condition as part of an "if" statement.
element.title: Condition statement

element.name: catalogSeqNumber
element.definition: The mandatory repeatable element <catalogSeqNumber> is used to store the catalogue sequence number (CSN) and all related parts information.
element.title: Catalogue sequence number

element.name: catalogSeqNumberRef
element.definition: The element <catalogSeqNumberRef> provides a reference to the IPD CSN that corresponds to the equipment. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.7.
element.title: Catalog sequence number reference

element.name: categoryOneContainerLocation
element.definition: The element <categoryOneContainerLocation> is used to record the location at which the data record of an item’s category 1 container is held.
element.title: Category 1 container location

element.name: caution
element.definition: The element <caution> contains hazard information that can cause damage to the Product.
element.title: Cautions

element.name: challenge
element.definition: The element <challenge> is used to identify a crew/operator challenge and response.
element.title: Challenge

element.name: challengeAndResponse
element.definition: The element <challengeAndResponse> is used to identify a crew/operator challenge and response.
element.title: Crew/operator challenge and response

element.name: changeAuthorityNumber
element.definition: The element <changeAuthorityNumber> is used to store the change authority number (CAN).
element.title: Change authority number

element.name: changeInline
element.definition: The element <changeInline> must be used for changed data modules when changing parts of text within certain elements (eg paragraphs, titles etc) that contain the <changeInline> element.
element.title: General rules for marking text as changed

element.name: checkList
element.definition: The element <checkList> is used to contain the checklist information. It has an attribute checkListCategory which can be set to the checklist type. Checklist type is an organization or project specific business rule decision and is populated as described in Chap 3.9.6.1. For each category identified, an organization or project can establish business rules for which elements to use and/or how to markup checklists for each category type.
element.title: Checklist and maintenance planning information

element.name: checkListInfo
element.definition: Checklist information includes a variety of optional elements and repeatable elements allowing for markup in a variety of ways. The check list information is intended to group items together that will create the checklist data. This element includes the following elements.
element.title: Check list information

element.name: checkListIntervals
element.definition: The element <checkListIntervals> contains an optional and repeatable element <checkListInterval>. This element is used to capture the various maintenance intervals used in an inspection or checklist. These intervals can be used to capture information for use with maintenance interval columns. For example, a table might have a column for 500 hours and a column for 1000 hours. These columns would then have a check mark in the appropriate task row to indicate when the maintenance should be performed.
element.title: Check list intervals

element.name: checkListItem
element.definition: The repeatable element <checkListItem> contains a number of elements used to capture items specific for an inspection or maintenance check. The element <checkListItem> presents an optional item number, followed by an optional threshold. It continues with a choice of equipment or nomenclature and a choice of references and check list procedures. The next two items are an optional zone and optional remarks. These items are detailed in paragraphs that follow.
element.title: Check list item

element.name: checkListProcedure
element.definition: The element <checkListProcedure> is used to contain a brief description of each check to be performed as well as any information required to accomplish a check or service. This element contains either paragraph text or a series of check list steps.
element.title: Check list procedure

element.name: circuitBreakerAlt
element.definition: This element contains the properties of the circuit breaker that depend on the Product configuration. Thus this element contains applicability.
element.title: Alternate circuit breaker

element.name: circuitBreakerClass
element.definition: This element indicates whether the circuit breaker is electronic or electro-mechanic.
element.title: Circuit breaker class

element.name: circuitBreakerDescr
element.definition: The element <circuitBreakerDescr> contains the information on individual circuit breakers.
element.title: Circuit breaker description

element.name: circuitBreakerDescrGroup
element.definition: The element <circuitBreakerDescrGroup> contains the circuit breaker lists information.
element.title: Circuit breaker description group

element.name: circuitBreakerDescrSubGroup
element.definition: The element <circuitBreakerDescrSubGroup> contains one or more sub circuit breaker lists.
element.title: Circuit breaker description subgroup

element.name: circuitBreakerIdent
element.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, this element identifies semantically the functional item as a result of its attributes.
element.title: Circuit breaker identifier

element.name: circuitBreakerLocation
element.definition: The element <circuitBreakerLocation> contains the textual description of the circuit breaker location in the circuit breaker panel.
element.title: Circuit breaker location

element.name: circuitBreakerRef
element.definition: The element <circuitBreakerRef> contains the details about the circuit breaker, eg number, circuit breaker action and circuit breaker type.
element.title: Circuit breaker reference

element.name: circuitBreakerRepository
element.definition: This element is used to provide a list of circuit breakers and their associated properties.
element.title: Circuit Breaker Repository

element.name: circuitBreakerSpec
element.definition: This element represents one circuit breaker. It contains its associated properties.
element.title: Circuit breaker specification

element.name: circuitIdent
element.definition: Projects with electrical wiring often consist of several systems or circuits. If the allocation of a wire to a system must be reflected in the wire identification, the circuit code must be populated with the identifier for this system/circuit.
element.title: Circuit code

element.name: city
element.definition: The element <city> contains the name of the city where the business is located.
element.title: City

element.name: clippingPoint
element.definition: The clipping points of a wire that fasten it to the structure of an aircraft, an equipment etc, are listed in the <clippingPoint> elements. If used, every clipping point must be populated in exactly one of the <clippingPoint> elements, ie the clipping point identification contains one clipping point that fastens the wire to the structure.
element.title: Clipping point information

element.name: closeRqmts
element.definition: The element <closeRqmts> contains any actions that are required after the Procedure is complete.
element.title: Requirements after job completion

element.name: coaxialCableFlag
element.definition: The coax information element <coaxialCableFlag> identifies coaxial contacts.
element.title: Coaxial information

element.name: colspec
element.definition: The element <colspec> (column specification) is used in the table group (<tgroup>, refer to Para 2.5.1) and can be overridden by <colspec> elements in the table header (<thead>, refer to Para 2.5.2), table footer (<tfoot>, refer to Para 2.5.3) and the table body (<tbody>, refer to Para 2.5.4). When used in the table header, table footer and table body, the values specified override those that can be present on the table group and these values are in turn overridden by the settings of the same attributes on individual rows and entries
element.title: Column specification

element.name: comment
element.definition: The comment data module consists of two main sections of information: the identification and status section and the content section.
element.title: Comment

element.name: commentAddress
element.definition: The comment address consists of two blocks of information items used to address the comment object, the comment identification and the supplementary comment address items.
element.title: Comment address

element.name: commentAddressItems
element.definition: Supports the identification of a comment object.
element.title: Comment address items

element.name: commentCode
element.definition: The comment code comprises up to 29 alphanumeric characters. It is built up as shown in Table 2. The minimum length is 17 characters.
element.title: Comment code

element.name: commentContent
element.definition: The content section contains the comment and/or the response to a comment.
element.title: Content section

element.name: commentIdent
element.definition: The comment identification establishes the unique identity of a comment object.
element.title: Comment identification

element.name: commentOriginator
element.definition: Describes the originator of the comment. Details of the originator (name, phone number, etc.) must be given.
element.title: Originator

element.name: commentPriority
element.definition: This element contains the priority of the comment.
element.title: Comment priority

element.name: commentRefs
element.definition: This element contains the reference to the information the comment is referring to. References are allowed to publication modules (including the entire publication set via list of applicable publications), data modules, data module lists or data dispatch notes. For each comment raised, there must be at least one reference. This element must not be used for responses to the comment (use subelement <noReferences>).
element.title: Comment references

element.name: commentResponse
element.definition: This element indicates the type of response to the comment.
element.title: Comment response

element.name: commentStatus
element.definition: Describes the status of the comment form.
element.title: Comment status

element.name: commonInfo
element.definition: The element <commonInfo> contains descriptive information that applies to an entire data module.
element.title: Common information

element.name: commonInfoDescrPara
element.definition: The element <commonInfoDescrPara> is used to contain text information.
element.title: Descriptive Paragraph Definition

element.name: componentAssy
element.definition: The element <componentAssy> is used to identify the item name or nomenclature (a basic name and a noun word or phrase modifier, eg transformer) and must be marked up using the element <name>. Parts that are not subject to maintenance must not be listed.
element.title: Component assembly

element.name: componentAssyGroup
element.definition: The element <componentAssyGroup> is used when there is a requirement to subdivide the list into subassemblies.
element.title: Component Assembly Group

element.name: condCrossRefTableRef
element.definition: The element <condCrossRefTableRef> provides a reference to the CCT data module for this project.
element.title: CCT reference

element.name: condIncorporation
element.definition: The element <condIncorporation> represents a technical condition that has or is planned to be incorporated into the technical data. It can reference a declared condition (element <cond>) and consists of a list of documents affected by the technical condition.
element.title: Condition incorporation

element.name: condList
element.definition: The element <condList> contains a list of specific conditions which have an effect on the applicability of technical data.
element.title: Conditions list

element.name: condType
element.definition: The element <condType> is used to define a single condition type of the Product.
element.title: Condition type

element.name: condTypeList
element.definition: The element <condTypeList> contains a list of common types of conditions which will be used as a basis for defining specific conditions.
element.title: Condition types list

element.name: conduit
element.definition: The element <conduit> is contained in the list of conduits element <conduitGroup>. The list of conduits is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
element.title: Element <conduit>

element.name: connectionListClass
element.definition: The connection list class element <connectionListClass> describes special groups of equipment, eg switches, connectors etc, in coded form.
element.title: Connection list class

element.name: connector
element.definition: The element <connector> is contained in the connector list element <connectorGroup>. The list of connectors is a child element of the list of standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
element.title: Element <connector> and child elements

element.name: connectorAccessories
element.definition: The element <connectorAccessories> contains the part numbers of accessories for the connector.
element.title: List of accessories

element.name: contact
element.definition: This element describes the contact identification by its attributes. Normally, wires are connected to contacts with designation identification. If not, the contact designation identification attribute contactIdent has no value for those contacts where at least one of the other attributes is used. If none of the attributes is used, the element <contact> must not be used at all.
element.title: Contact identification

element.name: contactCount
element.definition: The element <contactCount> contains the number of contacts of the connector.
element.title: Contact count

element.name: contactDescr
element.definition: The element <contactDescr> contains a list of contact descriptions.
element.title: Contact description

element.name: contactDescrGroup
element.definition: The element <contactDescrGroup> contains a list of contact descriptions.
element.title: List of contact descriptions

element.name: contactDiameter
element.definition: This element describes the diameter of a contact.
element.title: Contact diameter

element.name: contactInfo
element.definition: The contact information element contains child elements that identify the contact to which the wire end is connected.
element.title: Contact information

element.name: contactOrderValue
element.definition: The contact order element <contactOrderValue> is used to order the wire ends, connected to equipment with internal logic, in addition to the termination module, block and shunt grouping elements.
element.title: Contact order information

element.name: contactPerson
element.definition: The element <contactPerson> is repeatable and contains all information related to individual contacts for a business unit.
element.title: Contact persons

element.name: contactPersonAddress
element.definition: The element <contactPersonAddress> contains the information required to identify the contact person.
element.title: Contact person address

element.name: contactSize
element.definition: The element <contactSize> contains size information about a distribution part, normally for a contact.
element.title: Contact size

element.name: container
element.definition: This element is used to provide the list of alternate data modules, that the "container" contains.
element.title: Container

element.name: content
element.definition: The element <content> contains the content section of the data module/ publication module.
element.title: Content section

element.name: contextAndIsolationInfo
element.definition: The element <contextAndIsolationInfo> contains the description of the context in which the fault is observed and information needed to isolate the faulty item.
element.title: Context and isolation information

element.name: contextRules
element.definition: The element <contextRules> can be repeated to give the rules for different contexts within a project. Business rules specified by a BREX data module, and concerned with how the information structures (ie schemas) can be used, must define the context to which they are related. The context can be the entire project or it can be information in accordance with one of the Schemas that are applied within the project. Rules given for a specific context override rules specified for all contexts. If rules are defined for an object more than once, the first occurrence of rules for that object takes precedence.
element.title: Context related rules

element.name: controlIndicatorDescr
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorDescr> is used to store information specific to a control or indicator.
element.title: Control or indicator description

element.name: controlIndicatorFunction
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorFunction> is used to store one or more brief descriptions of the control or indicator function.
element.title: Control or indicator function

element.name: controlIndicatorGroup
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorGroup> (one or more) is used to contain unique identification of controls and indicators, each grouped by equipment, assembly, or control panel.
element.title: Control or indicator group

element.name: controlIndicatorKey
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorKey> contains the illustration or index key of the control or indicator.
element.title: Control or indicator key

element.name: controlIndicatorName
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorName> contains the designation of the control or indicator.
element.title: Control or indicator designation

element.name: controlIndicatorRef
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorRef> contains the number and name of the controls or indicators and the reference to the control and indicator repository data module.
element.title: Controls and indicators

element.name: controlIndicatorRepository
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorRepository> is used to capture and represent control and indicator information.
element.title: Controls and indicators repository

element.name: controlIndicatorSpec
element.definition: The element <controlIndicatorSpec> contains control and indicator information including illustration or index key, designation, and description. This element is the target when a control or indicator is referenced from another data module (eg procedural data module), using the element <controlIndicatorRef>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.10.
element.title: Control and indicator information

element.name: copyright
element.definition: The element <copyright> contains the copyright statement.
element.title: Copyright

element.name: copyrightPara
element.definition: The element <copyrightPara> contains the copyright statement itself or provides a cross-reference to another data module, which contains the statement.
element.title: Copyright paragraph

element.name: correlatedFault
element.definition: The element <correlatedFault> contains the information on correlated faults.
element.title: Correlated faults

element.name: country
element.definition: The element <country> contains the International Standards Organisation (ISO) country code where the business is located.
element.title: Country Code

element.name: crew
element.definition: The mandatory element <crew> is the container for all crew/operator content (excluding references).
element.title: Crew

element.name: crewDrill
element.definition: The element <crewDrill> is used to contain a crew/operator drill.
element.title: Drill

element.name: crewDrillStep
element.definition: The element <crewDrillStep> is used to identify a step in a crew/operator data module.
element.title: Crew drill step

element.name: crewMember
element.definition: The empty, conditionally mandatory element <crewMember> is used to identify a crew/operator member.
element.title: Crew member

element.name: crewMemberGroup

element.name: description
element.definition: The element <description> is used to contain the descriptive information. Descriptive paragraphs can be broken down into subparagraphs, which can be broken down further into sub-subparagraphs and so on. The depth of this breakdown is unlimited, however, it is recommended to not exceed five levels of depth. It is further recommended that additional levels only be used in a conversion effort, where existing data is authored to such a depth and restructuring of data is not feasible. In these cases, the subparagraph breakdown must never exceed eight levels of depth. The project or the organization must decide on the depth of breakdown.

element.name: descrScreenCount
element.definition: The element <descrScreenCount> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the screen count element <screenCount>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Screen count description

element.name: descrSectionIdent
element.definition: The element <descrSectionIdent> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the section identification element <sectionIdent> under element <wireIdent>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Section identification description

element.name: descrShrinkSleeve
element.definition: The element <descrShrinkSleeve> contains all relevant elements to describe the shrink sleeve data elements of the project.
element.title: Shrink sleeve data/field descriptions

element.name: descrShuntGroupingValue
element.definition: The element <descrShuntGroupingValue> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the shunt grouping information element <shuntGroupingValue> under the contact description element <contactDescr>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Shunt grouping information description

element.name: descrSiblingPlugIdent
element.definition: The element <descrSiblingPlugIdent> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the reference designator element <referenceDesignator> under the sibling plug identification element <siblingPlugIdent>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Sibling plug identification description

element.name: descrSignalInfo
element.definition: The element <descrSignalInfo> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the signal information element <signalInfo>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Signal information description

element.name: descrSize
element.definition: The element <descrSize> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the size information element <size>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Size information description

element.name: descrSleeve
element.definition: The element <descrSleeve> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the part number element <partNumber> and the attribute sleeveMaterial of the harness sleeve element <sleeve>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Harness sleeve description

element.name: descrSolderSleeve
element.definition: The element <descrSolderSleeve> contains all relevant elements to describe the solder sleeve data elements of the project.
element.title: Solder sleeve data/field descriptions

element.name: descrSpecialTerminal
element.definition: The element <descrSpecialTerminal> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the special terminal information element <specialTerminal>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Special terminal information description

element.name: descrStandardPartGroup
element.definition: The element <descrStandardPartGroup> contains child elements, which describe the electrical standard parts data elements.
element.title: Standard parts data/field descriptions

element.name: descrSurfaceProtection
element.definition: The element <descrSurfaceProtection> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the surface protection information element <surfaceProtection>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Surface protection information description

element.name: descrSystemBreakdownCode
element.definition: The element <descrSystemBreakdownCode> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for system break down code element <systemBreakdownCode>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: System breakdown code description

element.name: descrTerminationModuleGroupingValue
element.definition: The element <descrTerminationModuleGroupingValue> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the termination module grouping information element <terminationModuleGroupingValue> under the contact description element <contactDescr>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Termination module grouping information description

element.name: descrThermoCoupleMinus
element.definition: The element <descrThermoCoupleMinus> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the thermo couple minus information element <thermoCoupleMinus>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Thermo couple minus information description

element.name: descrThermoCouplePlus
element.definition: The element <descrThermoCouplePlus> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the thermo couple plus information element <thermoCouplePlus>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Thermo couple plus information description

element.name: descrTransverseLink
element.definition: The element <descrTransverseLink> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the contact identification element <contact> under the electrical equipment connection element <electricalEquipConnection> of the transverse link element <transverseLink>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Transverse link information description

element.name: descrTriaxialCableFlag
element.definition: The element <descrTriaxialCableFlag> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the tri-axial information element <triaxialCableFlag>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Tri-axial information description

element.name: descrTwist
element.definition: The element <descrTwist> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the twist element <twist>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Twist information description

element.name: descrVoltage
element.definition: The element <descrVoltage> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the voltage information element <voltage>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Voltage information description

element.name: descrWallThickness
element.definition: The element <descrWallThickness> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wall thickness element <wallThickness>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wall thickness description

element.name: descrWire
element.definition: The element <descrWire> contains all relevant elements to describe the wire data elements of the project.
element.title: Wire data/field descriptions

element.name: descrWireColor
element.definition: The element <descrWireColor> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the color element <wireColor>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Color information description

element.name: descrWireConnectionCode
element.definition: The element <descrWireConnectionCode> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire connection code element <wireConnectionCode>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire connection code description

element.name: descrWireGauge
element.definition: The element <descrWireGauge> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire gauge element <wireGauge>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire gauge description

element.name: descrWireInfoCircuitIdent
element.definition: The element <descrWireInfoCircuitIdent> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the circuit code element <circuitIdent> under element <wireInfo>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire information circuit code description

element.name: descrWireInfoSectionIdent
element.definition: The element <descrWireInfoSectionIdent> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire section identification element <sectionIdent> under element <wireInfo>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire information section identification description

element.name: descrWireMaterial
element.definition: The element <descrWireMaterial> contains all relevant elements to describe the conduit data elements of the project.
element.title: Wire material data/field descriptions

element.name: descrWireNumber
element.definition: The element <descrWireNumber> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire number element <wireNumber>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire number description

element.name: descrWireRoute
element.definition: The element <descrWireRoute> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire route lane code element <wireRoute>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire route lane code description

element.name: descrWireSeqNumber
element.definition: The element <descrWireSeqNumber> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire sequential number element <wireSeqNumber>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire sequential number description

element.name: descrWireType
element.definition: The element <descrWireType> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire type element <wireType>. Refer to Para 2.1.
element.title: Wire type description

element.name: detailedFaultDescr
element.definition: The element <detailedFaultDescr> contains the detailed description of the isolated fault.
element.title: Detailed description of the isolated fault

element.name: detectedFault
element.definition: The element <detectedFault> contains information on detected faults.
element.title: Detected faults

element.name: detectedLruItem
element.definition: The element <detectedLruItem> contains the identification, name and abbreviation of the detected LRU.
element.title: Detected Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) item

element.name: detectedSruItem
element.definition: The element <detectedSruItem> contains the identification, name and abbreviation of the detected SRU.
element.title: Detected Shop Replaceable Unit (SRU) item

element.name: detectionInfo
element.definition: The element <detectionInfo> contains the information for detecting the fault.
element.title: Fault detecting information

element.name: diagnosticProcess
element.definition: The element <diagnosticProcess> contains a textual description of the reason and a reference to a repair procedure or any locating and repairing tasks and information on the faulty LRU.
element.title: Diagnostics

element.name: dialog
element.definition: The element <dialog> allows the logic engine to interact with the user. It provides a means to obtain variable values from the user by asking him a question. Refer to Para 2.3.5 for expanded coverage of this element.
element.title: Dialog

element.name: dialogAlt
element.definition: The element <dialogAlt> groups configuration or situation unique dialogs for display to the user. Only one or none will be displayed depending on the applicability assigned to each element <dialog> within the element <dialogAlt>. Refer to Para 2.3.4.2.
element.title: Dialog alternate

element.name: dialogGroup
element.definition: The element <dialogGroup> allows the positioning of multiple dialog elements in within one dialog either vertically or horizontally.
element.title: Dialog layout

element.name: dispatchAddress
element.definition: The address from where the comment/response is sent.
element.title: Dispatch address

element.name: dispatchPerson
element.definition: As applicable, the element contains information about the dispatch person who is the point of contact at the sending enterprise.
element.title: Dispatch person

element.name: displayName
element.definition: The element <displayName> is used to define text which can be used to help automated generation the human readable display text on an applicability annotation (see Chap 7.8).
element.title: Display name

element.name: displayText
element.definition: The optional element <displayText> provides a human readable and printable branch of the applicability annotation. For those projects that do not require computable applicability, the display text is the only part of the applicability annotation needed. For annotations, the repeatable simple paragraph element <simplePara> can be used. Refer to Chap 7.8 for the recommended format for the content of element <displayText>.
element.title: Human readable applicability annotation branch

element.name: distributionPart
element.definition: The element <distributionPart> is contained in the list of distribution parts element <distributionPartGroup>. The list of distribution parts is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
element.title: Element <distributionPart> and child elements

element.name: dmAddress
element.definition: The element <dmAddress> is used to contain the unique identification and additional information supporting the data module.
element.title: Identification part

element.name: dmAddressItems
element.definition: The element <dmAddressItems> contains information that is supplementary to the data module identification but not part of the unique identifier.
element.title: Date module address items

element.name: dmCode
element.definition: The element <dmCode> contains the data module code and forms part of the unique identifier of a data module. All data modules are allocated a data module code.
element.title: Data module code

element.name: dmEntry
element.definition: The data module entry gives the information items concerning a data module included in the data module requirement list.
element.title: Data module entry

element.name: dmIdent
element.definition: The element <dmIdent> is used to contain the unique identification of the data module.
element.title: Data module identification

element.name: dmIf
element.definition: A branch sends the user down separate data paths based on state information such as configuration information or how the user has answered questions. Branches can be nested.
element.title: Data module branch

element.name: dmlAddress
element.definition: The identification consists of two blocks of information items used to uniquely address the data module requirement list object.
element.title: Identification and status section

element.name: dmlCode
element.definition: Each data module requirement list is assigned a data module list code. Together with issue information it gives an identification that is unique within the S1000D domain.
element.title: Data module requirements list identification code

element.name: dmlContent
element.definition: The data module requirement list content is made up of a list of data module entries.
element.title: Data module requirements list content

element.name: dmLoop
element.definition: A loop repeats a sequence of information as long as the loop condition (based on state information) is true.
element.title: Data module loops

element.name: dmlRef
element.definition: In a data module requirement list, references can be made to other data module requirement lists (eg for partial data module requirement list). The references can be given by using the element <dmlCode> within the element <dmlRef>.
element.title: Reference

element.name: dmlRefGroup
element.definition: This element contains one or several references to data module lists to which the comment/response relates.
element.title: Data module list reference group

element.name: dmlStatus
element.definition: The status section provides information about the status of the list.
element.title: Data module requirements list status

element.name: dmNode
element.definition: A data module node represents technical information that is to be displayed on one screen. This screen can be scrollable.
element.title: Data module node

element.name: dmNodeAlt
element.definition: An alternative (or conditional) node is a group of objects one or none of which will be applicable and thus displayed in a given situation.
element.title: Alternative data module node

element.name: dmRef
element.definition: The element <dmRef> contains details of the destination data module that is referred from some other S1000D context, such as a data module, a publication module etc.
element.title: References to data modules

element.name: dmRefAddressItems
element.definition: The element <dmRefAddressItems> contains additional identifying information about the destination data module.
element.title: Complementary identifying information for a data module

element.name: dmRefGroup
element.definition: This element contains one or several references to data modules to which the comment/response relates.
element.title: Data module reference group

element.name: dmRefIdent
element.definition: The element <dmRefIdent> contains the items forming a unique identification of the destination data module.
element.title: Identification of a referred data module

element.name: dmSeq
element.definition: A data module sequence determines the order of steps, dialogs, external application calls, data module references, and/or conditional actions within the data module.
element.title: Data module sequences

element.name: dmStatus
element.definition: The element <dmStatus> contains information about the status of the data module.
element.title: Status part

element.name: dmTitle
element.definition: The element <dmTitle> contains the title of the data module. The data module title must give meaning to the Product identification and action elements of the data module code. Authoring of titles must be in accordance with Chap 3.9.5.2.1.5.
element.title: Data module title

element.name: documentIncorporation
element.definition: The element <documentIncorporation> is used to list the data modules and publications that this technical condition affects.
element.title: Document incorporation

element.name: effectivity
element.definition: The element <effectivity> is used to identify a range of units or engines to which the item is fitted in this location.
element.title: Effectivity

element.name: electricalEquip
element.definition: The element <electricalEquip> is contained within the list of electrical equipment element <electricalEquipGroup>. It contains electrical equipment information of the Product's wiring.
element.title: Element <electricalEquip> and child elements

element.name: electricalEquipConnection
element.definition: The electrical equipment connection element <electricalEquipConnection> gives information about the electrical connections that belong to a transverse link.
element.title: Electrical equipment connections

element.name: electricalEquipState
element.definition: The electrical equipment state element <electricalEquipState> provides state information for each connection to some particular electrical equipment.
element.title: Electrical equipment state

element.name: electricalLogic
element.definition: The electrical logic element <electricalLogic> provides an optional container for electrical states and internal connections between contacts for electrical or electronic equipment.
element.title: Electrical logic

element.name: electricalPotential
element.definition: The electrical potential element <electricalPotential> is used to order the wires based on project or organization specific rules, using the relation to termination module, block and shunt or pole and position, and the contact identification.
element.title: Electrical potential

element.name: electricalStateDescr
element.definition: The electrical state description element <electricalStateDescr> contains the narrative description of an electrical state, eg “ENERGIZED".
element.title: Electrical state description

element.name: elseIf
element.definition: The element <elseIf> is used to identify an "if" statement to be used if another "if" condition is not met.
element.title: Else-if statement

element.name: email
element.definition: The element <email> is repeatable and contains contact fax numbers for the business.
element.title: Email addresses

element.name: emphasis
element.definition: The element <emphasis> contains eg a word, an expressions or a sentence to be highlighted.
element.title: Emphasis

element.name: enabledState
element.definition: The element <enabledState> contains an expression that evaluates state variables to determine if data entry field input is permitted or inhibited (usually the data entry is visible, but dimmed or grayed out).
element.title: User enabling/disabling entry

element.name: endMatter
element.definition: The element <endMatter> is used to contain end matter using the element <para>.
element.title: End matter statement

element.name: enterprise
element.definition: The name of the enterprise, and when applicable body within an enterprise, from where the comment/response is sent.
element.title: Enterprise

element.name: enterpriseIdent
element.definition: The element <enterpriseIdent> identifies the enterprise, through its CAGE code.
element.title: Enterprise identification

element.name: enterpriseIdentAlt
element.definition: The element <enterpriseIdentAlt> provides an alternate method of identifying an enterprise where the enterprise doesn’t have a CAGE code.
element.title: Alternate enterprise identification

element.name: enterpriseName
element.definition: The responsible partner company name element <enterpriseName> gives the name of the company or the organization, which is responsible for the data.
element.title: Responsible partner company name

element.name: enterpriseRef
element.definition: The element <enterpriseRef> is repeatable provides a method to refer other enterprises.
element.title: Enterprise references

element.name: enterpriseRepository
element.definition: The element <enterpriseRepository> contains a list of one or more element enterprise descriptions
element.title: Enterprise list

element.name: enterpriseSpec
element.definition: The element <enterpriseSpec> contains the unique enterprise information for any enterprise that is involved in the development or supply of the product. It contains information about the enterprise such as manufacturer code, enterprise name, and business unit.
element.title: Enterprise specification

element.name: entry
element.definition: The element <entry> (table entry) represents a table cell.
element.title: Table entry

element.name: enumeration
element.definition: The element <enumeration> provides the allowable values for the product attribute. The allowable values can be used to assist the technical author in creating applicability annotations.
element.title: Enumeration

element.name: equip
element.definition: The element <equip> provides a means to identify an individual piece of equipment associated with the task.
element.title: Equipment

element.name: equipDescrRef
element.definition: The equipment description reference element <equipDescrRef> contains references to other parts of the electrical system publications, which give further information about this equipment, such as the description of how it is made.
element.title: Equipment description reference

element.name: equipGroup
element.definition: The element <equipGroup> provides a means to identify the equipments associated with the task.
element.title: Equipment group

element.name: equipName
element.definition: The electrical equipment name element <equipName> describes the equipment. A standard name like SWITCH can be used or a name that defines the equipment in conjunction with its use on the system, eg BATTERY MASTER SWITCH.
element.title: Electrical equipment name

element.name: equipNotAvailable
element.definition: The element <equipNotAvailable> defines the condition of the equipment (shortages, malfunctions, etc.) that will make equipment not ready or not available for use. This element is aligned with the checklist item or paragraph for which the equipment not ready/available is applicable. This element includes a required element <para>.
element.title: Equipment not available

element.name: estimatedTime
element.definition: The element <estimatedTime> contains the estimate of the time that the person will be required on the task. The time must be given in hours with one decimal, eg 2,4 h, or days, eg 1,5 d. The time and unit of measurement must be entered.
element.title: Estimated time

element.name: evaluate
element.definition: The element <evaluate> is used to group tests together and provide the logical operation to apply to the test results. The element <evaluate> must be used whenever more than one test, element <assert>, is required. The element <evaluate> can contain other element <evaluate> and is therefore recursive. This allows for very complicated applicability annotations to be represented with a simple structure consisting of only two element types.
element.title: Grouping applicability tests - evaluate

element.name: excludedModification
element.definition: The element <excludedModification> contains an indication that the modification is not covered even though it was actually required.
element.title: Excluded modification

element.name: exportControl
element.definition: This element is used to define any government regulations concerning access to the data module.
element.title: Export control

element.name: exportRegistrationCode
element.definition: This element is used to indicate a coded value representing an export control property that applies to the content of the data module.
element.title: Export registration code

element.name: exportRegistrationStmt
element.definition: This element is used to specify either a full or partial export control statement describing the export status of the data module content.
element.title: Export statement

element.name: expression
element.definition: Expressions are combinations of variables and operators. The logic engine evaluates expressions primarily in order to determine what is displayed to the user as in applicability ([Model = "T"]) and branching ([If Error Condition = "4"]) and loop (WHILE [Counter < "5" ]) conditions. Expressions are also used to assign a value to a variable ([Ave = Sum / 3]). Refer to Chap 7.6.1 entitled "Expression evaluation" for detailed information.
element.title: Expressions

element.name: externalApplication
element.definition: The element <externalApplication> is a mechanism for launching an external application in the midst of a process data module. This application might be a wiring data viewer, a calculator, a diagnostic test, etc. Refer to Para 2.3.8 for expanded coverage of this element.
element.title: External application

element.name: externalPubCode
element.definition: The element <externalPubCode> contains, as text content, a code that identifies a non S1000D document, such as an ISBN code or similar.
element.title: Identifying code of an external document

element.name: externalPubIssue
element.definition: The element <externalPubIssue> contains, as text content, issue designation of a non S1000D document.
element.title: Issue information of an external document

element.name: externalPubIssueInfo
element.definition: The element <externalPubIssueInfo> contains issue information concerning e referred non S1000D document.
element.title: Issue information of an external document

element.name: externalPubRef
element.definition: The element <externalPubRef> contains the identification of a referenced non S10000D publication or document.
element.title: References to external documents

element.name: externalPubRefAddressItems
element.definition: The element <externalPubRefAddressItems> contains, as text content, additional information potentially useful to identify the external destination publication or document.
element.title: Complementary identifying information for an external document

element.name: externalPubRefIdent
element.definition: The element <externalPubRefIdent> contains the identification of the non S1000D publication or document.
element.title: Identification of an external document

element.name: externalPubTitle
element.definition: The element <externalPubTitle> contains, as text content, a code that identifies a non S1000D document, such as an ISBN code or similar.
element.title: Title of an external document

element.name: externalSco
element.definition: The element <externalSco> is used to identify any external SCOs, which are required within the current SCO. The elements <title> and <filename>, which identifies the file for the external SCO, are required. The use of <externalSco > should be explained in the business rules.
element.title: External SCO references

element.name: extraResources
element.definition: The element <extraResources> is used to references all figures and multimedia required to appear in the SCO. The elements <figure> and <multimedia> can be used, as required.
element.title: Extra SCO resources

element.name: fastener
element.definition: This element is used to store access point fastener information.
element.title: Fastener

element.name: fastenerQuantity
element.definition: This element is used to indicate the quantity of fasteners.
element.title: Fastener quantity

element.name: fastenerType
element.definition: This element is used to indicate the type of the fastener.
element.title: Fastener type

element.name: faultDescr
element.definition: The element <faultDescr> contains the description of the isolated fault.
element.title: Description of the isolated fault

element.name: faultIsolation
element.definition: The fault isolation branch of the Schema identifies and describes the fault and gives the diagnostic path to isolate a faulty item.
element.title: Fault isolation

element.name: faultIsolationProcedure
element.definition: The element <faultIsolationProcedure> contains the detailed fault isolation procedure including fault code, fault description.
element.title: Fault isolation procedure

element.name: faultIsolationTest
element.definition: The element <faultIsolationTest > contains the test description, test parameters and the test procedure.
element.title: Fault isolation test performance

element.name: faultReporting
element.definition: The element <faultReporting > contains information to enable technician or computerized maintenance systems to indicate faults through data modules.
element.title: Fault reporting

element.name: faxNumber
element.definition: The element <faxNumber> is repeatable and contains contact fax numbers for the business.
element.title: FAX numbers

element.name: feedThru
element.definition: If a wire passes through equipment, eg a current transformer, this is identified by using the feed-through element <feedThru>.
element.title: Feed-through information

element.name: fieldName
element.definition: The data/field name element <fieldName> contains the name of the data field, ie the project or the organization specific naming of electrical data.
element.title: Data/field name

element.name: figure
element.definition: This element contains the figure. The figure consists of a title and one or more illustrations sheets and a figure title. It can also contain a legend.
element.title: General

element.name: finishingInfo
element.definition: The element <finishingInfo> contains the finishing information for the connection of wires to a contact. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.9.2.
element.title: Finishing information

element.name: firstName
element.definition: The element <firstName> contains the first name of the individual contact.
element.title: First name

element.name: firstVerification
element.definition: The element <firstVerification> contains identifies a data module which has been first verified. For details on verification, refer to Chap 3.7.
element.title: First verification

element.name: fitmentCode
element.definition: The element <fitmentCode> is used to indicate whether an item can be fitted as supplied.
element.title: Fitment code

element.name: foldout
element.definition: The element <foldout> is used to contain a figure, or table which is larger than the default size.
element.title: Foldouts

element.name: footnote
element.definition: The element <footnote> contains can eg bibliographic references or explanations which would take too much space or in any other way would be annoying for the reader.
element.title: Footnote

element.name: footnoteRef
element.definition: The element <footnoteRef> contains the link to a previously defined footnote. The same link is used to reference the same footnote many times.
element.title: Footnote reference

element.name: frequency
element.definition: The element <frequency> contains the frequency of wire material in relation to the attenuation.
element.title: Frequency

element.name: frequencyAttenuation
element.definition: The element <frequencyAttenuation> is a repeatable container for frequency and attenuation information of wire material.
element.title: Frequency and attenuation

element.name: frequencyCharacteristics
element.definition: The element <frequencyCharacteristics> contains alternating current (AC) frequency characteristics of wire material.
element.title: Frequency characteristics

element.name: fromEquip
element.definition: The content model electrical equipment defines the child elements of elements <fromEquip> and <toEquip>, which contain the wire connection information for the two wire ends.
element.title: Content model electrical equipment

element.name: functionalDescrRef
element.definition: The functional description reference element <functionalDescrRef> contains references to other parts of the electrical system publications for further information about a wire, eg a description of how it is made and its function. References must be populated in accordance with Chap 3.9.5.2.1.2.
element.title: Functional description reference

element.name: functionalItemAlt
element.definition: This element contains the properties of the functional item that depend on the Product configuration. Thus this element contains applicability.
element.title: Alternate functional item

element.name: functionalItemCode
element.definition: The element <functionalItemCode> can contain a code that represents the functional breakdown.
element.title: Functional item code

element.name: functionalItemIdent
element.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, this element identifies semantically the functional item as a result of its attributes. The codification of functional item identifier is up to the project or the organization.
element.title: Functional item identifier

element.name: functionalItemRef
element.definition: The element <functionalItemRef> contains a functional item number.
element.title: Functional item reference

element.name: functionalItemRefGroup
element.definition: The element <functionalItemRef> contains a functional item number.
element.title: Functional item reference

element.name: functionalItemRepository
element.definition: This element is used to provide a list of functional items and their associated properties.
element.title: General

element.name: functionalItemSpec
element.definition: This element represents one functional item. It contains its associated properties.
element.title: Functional item specification

element.name: functionalPhysicalAreaIdent
element.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, the element <functionalPhysicalAreaIdent> identifies semantically the functional and/or physical area as a result of its attributes. In addition to the functional and/or physical area identifier, the system difference code can be specified for each functional and/or physical area.
element.title: Functional and/or physical area identifier

element.name: functionalPhysicalAreaRef
element.definition: The element <functionalPhysicalAreaRef> is used to markup a functional and/or physical area (outside of its specification in the functional and/or physical area technical repository) and also allows referring to its specification in the functional and/or physical area technical repository.
element.title: Functional and/or physical area

element.name: functionalPhysicalAreaRefGroup
element.definition: The element <functionalPhysicalAreaRefGroup> allows reflecting the functional and/or physical breakdown. If used, it must only contain the links from a functional and/or physical area to its direct children.
element.title: References to other functional and/or physical areas

element.name: functionalPhysicalAreaRepository
element.definition: The element <functionalPhysicalAreaRepository> is used to provide a list of functional and/or physical areas and their associated properties.
element.title: General

element.name: functionalPhysicalAreaSpec
element.definition: This element represents one functional and/or physical area and its properties.
element.title: Functional and/or physical area specification

element.name: genericPartData
element.definition: The element <genericPartData> is used to identify the specific version of the equipment to which the item is fitted in this location.
element.title: Generic Part data

element.name: genericPartDataGroup
element.definition: The element <genericPartDataGroup> is used to store any program specific data.
element.title: Non S2000M data

element.name: genericPartDataValue
element.definition: The element <genericPartDataValue> is used to store the non S2000M element value.
element.title: Generic Part data value

element.name: graphic
element.definition: This element contains the external entity reference to the illustration file.
element.title: Graphic

element.name: groupCode
element.definition: The group code element <groupCode> indicates the physical grouping of wires connected to the same contact. For example, where multiple wires are connected to a terminal stud using multiple ring terminals, each wire connected to the same ring terminal must have the same group code, eg A. Wires that are connected to the same terminal stud but to another ring terminal must have another group code, eg B. This means that an identical group code indicates wires, which are physically connected to the same ring terminal.
element.title: Group code

element.name: groupNumber
element.definition: The element <groupNumber> is used to capture the functional item group of the end item. The functional group applies to repairable assemblies and subassemblies, ie spares (any repairable component required for the maintenance or repair of an end item), but not to repair parts (any consumable, non-repairable component required for the maintenance or repair of an end item).
element.title: Maintenance allocation group number

element.name: harness
element.definition: The element <harness> is contained within the list of harnesses element <harnessGroup>. It contains harness information of the Product's wiring. The electrical wires of a system are often divided into separate harnesses.
element.title: Element <harness> and child elements

element.name: harnessEnvironment
element.definition: The element <harnessEnvironment> gives information concerning the environment in which a harness is located.
element.title: Harness environment

element.name: harnessIdent
element.definition: The harness identification is the unique identifier of a harness in the system. It is the link between the harness and the included wires.
element.title: Harness identification

element.name: harnessInfo
element.definition: The element <harnessInfo> contains harness information for the detailed identification of a harness, eg the part number and alternative identifications that can be used to identify this harness.
element.title: Harness information

element.name: harnessName
element.definition: The harness name element <harnessName> gives the name of a harness.
element.title: Harness name

element.name: harnessSize
element.definition: The element <harnessSize> describes the minimum and the maximum size of the harness, to which a shrink sleeve can be applied.
element.title: Harness size

element.name: harnessVariantIdent
element.definition: The harness variant identification element <harnessVariantIdent> contains the variant of a harness. Improvements during series production or engineering requirements are reasons why different harnesses are used in one type of system. This element identifies the different harnesses. A harness variant can be part of the project or the organization specific part number.
element.title: Harness variant

element.name: harnessVariantIssue
element.definition: The harness variant issue element <harnessVariantIssue> contains the issue of a harness variant.
element.title: Harness issue

element.name: hotspot
element.definition: The element <hotspot> contains the definition of graphical regions in an illustration and contains information needed to navigate between graphical objects or between graphical objects and text. For use of the element <hotspot> in the context of a learning assessment, refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.13.5.
element.title: Hotspot

element.name: hoursToOpen
element.definition: This element indicates the elapsed time necessary to open the access point.
element.title: Elapsed time to open the access point

element.name: identAndStatusSection
element.definition: The element <identAndStatusSection> is used to contain the identification and status of a data module/ publication module, which are captured in the two parts, identification and status.
element.title: Identification and status section

element.name: identExtension
element.definition: The element <identExtension> establishes a producer unique subdomain for instance identification.
