The identification extension gives the additional parameters needed to establish a unique identification of a data module/ publication in those cases when data module code/ publication module, issue and in-work numbers together with the language and country are insufficient to form a universally unique identity.
element.title: Identification extension

element.name: identNumber
element.definition: The element <identNumber> contains the manufacturer's identification information.
element.title: Identification number

element.name: identSleeve
element.definition: The element <identSleeve> is contained in the list of identification sleeves element <identSleeveGroup>. The list of identification sleeves is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
element.title: Element <identSleeve> and child elements

element.name: if
element.definition: The element <if> is used to identify an "if" statement.
element.title: If statement

element.name: illustratedPartsCatalog
element.definition: The element <illustratedPartsCatalog> is used to contain the illustrated parts catalog information of a data module (excluding references).
element.title: Illustrated parts catalog

element.name: illustrationRef
element.definition: The illustration reference element <illustrationRef> contains references to other parts of the electrical system publications.
element.title: Illustration reference

element.name: ilsNumber
element.definition: The element <ilsNumber> contains an interdisciplinary cross reference to an integrated logistic support number.
element.title: Integrated logistic support number

element.name: impedance
element.definition: The element <impedance> contains the AC impedance of the wire material, normally of a cable.
element.title: Impedance

element.name: incorporation
element.definition: The element <incorporation> gives the incorporation status of technical conditions in the documentation.
element.title: Incorporation status list

element.name: incorporationStatus
element.definition: The element <incorporationStatus> is used to define the status of the incorporation of a technical condition.
element.title: Incorporation status

element.name: indexFlag
element.definition: The element <indexFlag> is used to contain the text of an item that is required to be included in an automatically generated index.
element.title: Index

element.name: infoName
element.definition: The element <infoName> is linked to the information code using the attribute infoCode. Normally the information name is the short description of the information code. For example, information code 520 will have information name "Remove procedure". Projects can decide to modify (or extend) the information name to one that is more suitable, provided the sense of the information code is maintained. An example of where this could be used would be the information code 251 is "Clean procedures". A project can have a data module that tells the reader how to clean with water (this could be 251A) another data module could tell the reader how to clean with air (this could be 251B). In both cases, the information name can be extended from "Clean procedures" to "Clean procedures (clean with water)" and "Clean procedures (clean with air)".
element.title: Information name

element.name: initialize
element.definition: The element <initialize> is used to set an initial value for the variable using element <expression>.
element.title: Initialize

element.name: initialProvisioningProject
element.definition: The element <initialProvisioningProject> is used to store information regarding the Initial Provisioning Project (IPP).
element.title: Initial provisioning project number

element.name: initialProvisioningProjectRef
element.definition: The element <initialProvisioningProjectRef> is used to contain only a reference to another IPP for non-chapterized IPD (in an electronic (IPDP) it mainly will address the first CSN of this referenced IPPN).
element.title: Refer to IPP

element.name: inlineSignificantData
element.definition: The element <inlineSignificantData> contains a significant meaning, such as a lubricant or manufacturer code.
element.title: Paragraph significant data

element.name: inspection
element.definition: The element <inspection> groups the inspection limit information with the associated remark information.
element.title: Inspection information

element.name: inspectionDefinition
element.definition: This element contains information about inspections. Inspections are a way to group tasks that are related to the topic or intent of the inspection. This element groups a set of tasks with the limit information associated to perform the set of tasks.
element.title: Inspection definition

element.name: inspectionType
element.definition: The element <inspectionType> provides a classification of maintenance into various types such as "systems", "structural" and "zonal".
element.title: Inspection type

element.name: installationInfo
element.definition: The element <installationInfo> contains electrical equipment installation information. The element is repeatable to cover multiple occurrence equipment.
element.title: Installation information

element.name: installationLocation
element.definition: The repeatable element <installationLocation> contains the installation location information of the equipment instances.
element.title: Installation location

element.name: interchangeability
element.definition: The element <interchangeability> is used to record the interchangeability of two or more items at the same location. This element will only be populated if the element <reasonForSelection> is not set to "0".
element.title: Interchangeability

element.name: internalRef
element.definition: The element <internalRef> is used to mark up a cross-reference from one point in a data module to another point in the same data module. This is achieved using the normal ID/IDREF mechanism, refer to Para 2.1.1.1.
element.title: Internal reference

element.name: internet
element.definition: The element <internet> is repeatable and contains internet addresses for the business.
element.title: Internet addresses

element.name: isolateDetectedFault
element.definition: The element <isolateDetectedFault > contains the information needed to isolate the detected fault to an LRU from amongst a list of suspected LRU. This is done by referring out to another data module through the element <faultIsolationRef> or by describing a test on these LRU using the element <lruItem>.
element.title: Isolate detected fault

element.name: isolatedFault
element.definition: The element <isolatedFault> is used to capture isolated faults information.
element.title: Isolated faults

element.name: isolationInfo
element.definition: The element <isolationInfo> contains the diagnostic information for the observed fault. This is done by referring out using the element <faultIsolationRef> or by describing a diagnostic process using the element <diagnosticProcess> or simply testing the LRU using the element <lruItem>.
element.title: Fault isolation information

element.name: isolationMainProcedure
element.definition: The element <isolationMainProcedure> contains the individual isolation steps.
element.title: Main isolation procedure

element.name: isolationProcedure
element.definition: The element <isolationProcedure> contains the isolation procedure including preliminary requirements and closeup requirements.
element.title: Isolation procedure

element.name: isolationProcedureEnd
element.definition: The element <isolationProcedureEnd> contains further isolation actions (these are either within the data module or referenced out to another data module) or to the element <closeRqmts> containing a closeup procedure.
element.title: Isolation procedure end

element.name: isolationStep
element.definition: The element <isolationStep> contains the textual description of the action, the question and answer alternatives. It can also include eg a title, warnings, cautions and note.
element.title: Fault isolation step

element.name: isolationStepAnswer
element.definition: The element <isolationStepAnswer> contains the answers to the corresponding question (element <isolationStepQuestion>). The answers are given in the form of a reference to another action, to one or more final actions (in element <isolationProcedureEnd>) or to close-up requirements <closeRqmts>.
element.title: Answer

element.name: issueDate
element.definition: The element <issueDate> contains date information for the data module/ publication module. Every issue whether initially written, completely revised or updated by changes, must be allocated an ISO 8601 calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD.
element.title: Issue date

element.name: issueInfo
element.definition: The element <issueInfo> contains the issue number of the data module/ publication module.
element.title: Issue information

element.name: itemDescr
element.definition: This element is used to contain the textual description of the father element.
element.title: Description

element.name: itemIdentData
element.definition: This element groups the properties that describe the part.
element.title: Description data

element.name: itemNumber
element.definition: The element <itemNumber> is assigned to the checklist item for reference purposes. It is used to identify the line item or the row number for data presented in tabular format.
element.title: Item number

element.name: itemSequenceNumber
element.definition: The mandatory, repeatable element <itemSequenceNumber> is used to store the Item Sequence Number (ISN). It also contains elements which store metadata about the item.
element.title: Item sequence number

element.name: jobTitle
element.definition: The element <jobTitle> contains the job title of the individual contact.
element.title: Job title

element.name: language
element.definition: The element <language> is used to describe the language in which the data module/ publication module is written.
element.title: Language

element.name: lastName
element.definition: The element <lastName> contains the last name of the individual contact.
element.title: Last name

element.name: lcAge
element.definition: The element <lcAge> describes the learners’ age range.
element.title: Age

element.name: lcAnswerOption
element.definition: The <lcAnswerOption> container element provides a single answer option for true-false, single-select, or multiple-select assessment interactions.
element.title: Answer option

element.name: lcAnswerOptionContent
element.definition: The <lcAnswerOptionContent> container element provides the content and feedback for an answer option to a question, and can indicate that the option is correct or incorrect.
element.title: Answer option content

element.name: lcAnswerOptionGroup
element.definition: The <lcAnswerOptionGroup> container element provides answer options for true-false, single-select, or multiple-select assessment interactions.
element.title: Answer option group

element.name: lcAssessment
element.definition: The element <lcAssessment> describes the manner in which the learning will be assessed. It is the high level design that captures how embedded, pre- and post-assessments will be employed.
element.title: Assessment

element.name: lcAsset
element.definition: The <lcAsset> element is used to hold images and other graphic assets to support an assessment interaction.
element.title: Asset

element.name: lcAttitude
element.definition: The element <lcAttitude> describes the mental state that influences the choices of personal actions.
element.title: Attitude

element.name: lcAudience
element.definition: The element <lcAudience> describes the learner's profile taking the instruction.
element.title: Audience

element.name: lcBackground
element.definition: The element <lcBackground> describes the learners’ professional background and the relevancy to the learning plan.
element.title: Background

element.name: lcChallenge
element.definition: The element <lcChallenge> describes student practice exercises. For example, if network diagrams are the subject matter, a challenge might be ?put this network into its proper sequence?.
element.title: Challenge

element.name: lcCIN
element.definition: The element <lcCIN> provides an alpha-numeric alternate identifier to the project title.
element.title: Course Identification Number

element.name: lcClassroom
element.definition: The element <lcClassroom> describes technical aspects of the course to take place in a classroom.
element.title: Classroom

element.name: lcClient
element.definition: The element <lcClient> provides the person or organization sponsoring or requiring the learning event development.
element.title: Client

element.name: lcConstraints
element.definition: The element <lcConstraints> describes constraints imposed by the technologies used to create, distribute, deliver, and display the instruction. For example, if constraints are not met, the learner will not experience the instruction as designed. These must be considered in light of how the instruction will be used in relation to the learning objectives.
element.title: Constraints

element.name: lcCorrectResponse
element.definition: The empty <lcCorrectResponse> element indicates a correct <lcOptionContent> response in a <lcAnswerOption>.
element.title: Correct response

element.name: lcDelivDate
element.definition: The element <lcDelivDate> provides the project delivery date.
element.title: Delivery Date

element.name: lcDelivery
element.definition: The element <lcDelivery> describes the instructional delivery methods and technologies. To maximize training effectiveness and optimize resource utilization, content developed should be founded upon needs and job task analysis data and leverage instructional delivery methods and technologies (eg, computer-based, web-based, video, performance support systems). A training delivery analysis includes review of the NLOS, identification and evaluation of available delivery options, and selection of the optimum delivery means.
element.title: Delivery

element.name: lcDownloadTime
element.definition: The element <lcDownloadTime> describes the maximum time allowed for download time in the client’s delivery environment.
element.title: Download Time

element.name: lcDuration
element.definition: The element <lcDuration> provides an estimated duration for the learning activity.
element.title: Duration

element.name: lcEdLevel
element.definition: The element <lcEdLevel> describes the range of learners’ education level and the relevancy to the learning plan.
element.title: Education Level

element.name: lcFeedback
element.definition: The <lcFeedback> element provides information to the learner about a correct or incorrect response during an interactive assessment.
element.title: Feedback

element.name: lcFeedbackCorrect
element.definition: The <lcFeedbackCorrect> element provides feedback to the learner about a correct response in an assessment interaction.
element.title: Feedback correct

element.name: lcFeedbackIncorrect
element.definition: The <lcFeedbackIncorrect> element provides feedback to the learner about an incorrect response in an assessment interaction.
element.title: Feedback incorrect

element.name: lcFileSizeLimitations
element.definition: The element <lcFileSizeLimitations> describes the file size limitations in the client’s delivery environment.
element.title: File Size Limitations

element.name: lcGapAnalysis
element.definition: The element <lcGapAnalysis> is the third high level container within the element <lcLearningPlan>. Analysis compares existing learning objectives to current job task analysis (JTA).
element.title: Gap Analysis

element.name: lcGapItem
element.definition: The element <lcGapItem> is a repeatable wrapper capturing gaps between existing training objectives and related job-task-analysis content.
element.title: Gap Item

element.name: lcGapItemDelta
element.definition: The element <lcGapItemDelta> describes the gap between the learning objective and the job task analysis.
element.title: Gap Item Delta

element.name: lcGeneralDescription
element.definition: The element <lcGeneralDescription> provides a space to develop a general description about the organization’s training needs.
element.title: General Description

element.name: lcGoals
element.definition: The element <lcGoals> describes the outcomes desired by the organization to be addressed by the training effort. These goals may require concurrent efforts outside of training such as technology acquisition, reorganization, and so forth.
element.title: Goals

element.name: lcGraphics
element.definition: The element <lcGraphics> describes standards and system requirements for displaying graphics, 3D animations from CAD, navigation through virtual spaces, etc.
element.title: Graphics

element.name: lcHotspot
element.definition: The hotspot interaction asks the assessment taker to click on a region of the screen to indicate a choice.
element.title: Hotspot

element.name: lcHotspotMap
element.definition: This interaction designates an action area or region over an image, allowing a click in that region to get scored as correct or incorrect in response to an interaction question. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.8.
element.title: Hotspot map

element.name: lcInstruction
element.definition: This element describes the specifics of a learning activity.
element.title: Instruction

element.name: lcInteraction
element.definition: The repeatable container element <lcInteraction> provides the assessment question interactions.
element.title: Interaction

element.name: lcIntervention
element.definition: The element <lcIntervention> is the fourth wrapper under the element <learningPlan>. It describes the approach and strategies to building the learning materials based on the element <lcNeedsAnalysis> content.
element.title: Intervention

element.name: lcInterventionItem
element.definition: The element <lcInterventionItem> is a repeatable wrapper describing how learning content is built. It describes the systems approach to analyzing, designing, developing, implementing, and evaluating any instructional experience.
element.title: Intervention Item

element.name: lcIntro
element.definition: The element <lcIntro> provides a detailed introduction and description of the content to be delivered, in cases where the <shortDescr> is not adequate to fully describe the content.
element.title: Introduction

element.name: lcItem
element.definition: The <lcItem> element contains content for an item that matches the matching item in a match table contained in a match table interaction.
element.title: Item

element.name: lcJtaItem
element.definition: The element <lcJtaItem> provides the description of job task analysis as related to a particular learning objective.
element.title: Job Task Analysis Item

element.name: lcLearnStrat
element.definition: The element <lcLearnStrat> describes the manner in which the learning content will be instructed. It should be a high level design that applies instructional-design theories and models.
element.title: Learning Strategy

element.name: lcLMS
element.definition: The element <lcLMS> describes the LMS name and version number.
element.title: LMS

element.name: lcMatching
element.definition: The matching interaction asks the assessment taker to link two related items together from a list of multiple options.
element.title: Matching

element.name: lcMatchingHeader
element.definition: The <lcMatchingHeader> container element provides column headings for items to be matched in a match table interaction.
element.title: Matching header

element.name: lcMatchingItem
element.definition: The <lcMatchingItem> element contains content for the matching side of a matching pair of items in a match table interaction.
element.title: Matching item

element.name: lcMatchingPair
element.definition: The <lcMatchingPair> container element provides a table row with the pair of items that comprise a correct match in a matching interaction.
element.title: Matching pair

element.name: lcMatchTable
element.definition: The <lcMatchTable> element contains a format for matching items in an assessment interaction.
element.title: Match table

element.name: lcModDate
element.definition: The element <lcModDate> provides the project modification date.
element.title: Modification Date

element.name: lcMotivation
element.definition: The element <lcMotovation> describes the reasons why the learners’ want and/or need to take the instruction.
element.title: Motivation

element.name: lcMultipleSelect
element.definition: A multiple select interaction presents the assessment taker with a question and three or more possible answers, where two or more answers are correct.
element.title: Multiple select

element.name: lcNeeds
element.definition: The element <lcNeeds> describes the needs behind the outcomes described in the element <lcGoals>.
element.title: Needs

element.name: lcNeedsAnalysis
element.definition: This is the second high level container element in the element <learningPlan>. It describes the training requirement and identifies the need to develop or revise content. These include periodic training gap analyses, changes to operational or maintenance requirements, and changes to equipment or systems.
element.title: Needs Analysis

element.name: lcNextSteps
element.definition: The element <lcNextSteps> describes the next steps to reinforce the knowledge learned.
element.title: Next steps

element.name: lcNoLMS
element.definition: The element <lcNoLMS> describes any technical requirements when SCORM and an LMS is not required.
element.title: NoLMS

element.name: lcObjective
element.definition: The element <lcObjective> describes a single learning objective.
element.title: Objective

element.name: lcObjectiveGroup
element.definition: The element <lcObjectiveGroup> provides contains a list of one or more learning objectives.
element.title: Objective group

element.name: lcObjectives
element.definition: The element <lcObjectives> lists or describes the learning goals.
element.title: Objectives

element.name: lcObjectivesStem
element.definition: The element <lcObjectivesStem> provides a leading sentence to introduce a list of learning objectives.
element.title: Objectives stem

element.name: lcOJT
element.definition: The element <lcOJT> describes technical aspects of the course taking place in the work environment.
element.title: On The Job Training

element.name: lcOrganizational
element.definition: The element <lcOrganizational> is the first wrapper within <lcNeedsAnalysis>. It describes the organization’s learning requirements.
element.title: Organizational

element.name: lcOrgConstraints
element.definition: The element <lcOrgConstraints> describes organizational aspects that may limit the organization’s ability to effectively use the instruction to meet its goals.
element.title: Organizational Constraints

element.name: lcPlanAudience
element.definition: The element <lcPlanAudience> is the second wrapper within the element <lcNeedsAnalysis>. It describes the learners’ profile taking the instruction.
element.title: Audience

element.name: lcPlanDescrip
element.definition: The element <lcPlanDescrip> provides a complete description of the learning plan.
element.title: Plan Description

element.name: lcPlanObjective
element.definition: The element <lcPlanObjective> describes actions, behaviors, conditions and standards required of the learner in order to complete a course.
element.title: Learning Plan Objective

element.name: lcPlanPreReqs
element.definition: The element <lcPlanPreReqs> provides the knowledge, skills, abilities, courses and other activities learners must have satisfied to take the instruction.
element.title: Plan Prerequisites

element.name: lcPlanResources
element.definition: The element <lcPlanResources> describes the materials available to learners for learning in the course of their daily routine. It may include computers, books, manuals, tutors.
element.title: Plan Resources

element.name: lcPlanSubject
element.definition: The element <lcPlanSubject> provides a complete description of the subject of the planned learning.
element.title: Subject

element.name: lcPlanTitle
element.definition: The element <lcPlanTitle> provides a title for the lesson plan.
element.title: Plan Title

element.name: lcPlayers
element.definition: The element <lcPlayers> describes tools used for time-sequenced display at runtime.
element.title: Players

element.name: lcProcesses
element.definition: The element <lcProcesses> describes processes learners routinely follow – ISO, SOPs, etc.
element.title: Processes

element.name: lcProject
element.definition: The element <lcProject> is the first high level container element in the element <learningPlan>. It contains the learning content project plan description.
element.title: Project

element.name: lcQuestion
element.definition: The <lcQuestion> element is used to hold a question in an assessment interaction.
element.title: Question

element.name: lcResolution
element.definition: The element <lcResolution> describes the required computer screen resolution delivered instruction.
element.title: Resolution

element.name: lcResources
element.definition: The element <lcResources> provides a list of related resources and information about them, such as related articles or samples on the web.
element.title: Resources

element.name: lcReview
element.definition: The element <lcReview> provides a review of the main points.
element.title: Review

element.name: lcSection
element.definition: The element <lcSection> provides a generic element to contain other learning content.
element.title: Section

element.name: lcSecurity
element.definition: The element <lcSecurity> describes the security requirements in the delivered instruction.
element.title: Security

element.name: lcSequence
element.definition: The <lcSequence> element provides the position of a sequence option in a sequence in an assessment interaction.
element.title: Sequence

element.name: lcSequenceOption
element.definition: This element contains the contents of an item to be sequenced within an assessment interaction.
element.title: Sequence option

element.name: lcSequenceOptionGroup
element.definition: The element <lcSequenceOptionGroup> provides the options for an assessment sequence interaction.
element.title: Sequence option group

element.name: lcSequencing
element.definition: The sequence interaction presents the assessment taker with a list of items that must be put into a correct sequential order.
element.title: Sequencing

element.name: lcSingleSelect
element.definition: A single select interaction presents the assessment taker with a question and three or more possible answers, only one of which is correct.
element.title: Single select

element.name: lcSkills
element.definition: The element <lcSkills> describes the learners’ current skill set and the relevancy to the learning plan.
element.title: Skills

element.name: lcSpecChars
element.definition: The element <lcSpecChars> describes learner characteristics specific to the population that will influence the design, including learning disabilities, physical handicaps, and so forth.
element.title: Special Characteristics

element.name: lcSummary
element.definition: The element <lcSummary> provides a textual summary that describes the main learning goals and lessons learned.
element.title: Summary

element.name: lcTask
element.definition: The element <lcTask> is the fourth wrapper within the element <lcNeedsAnalysis>. It captures a work item to be performed.
element.title: Task

element.name: lcTaskItem
element.definition: The element <lcTaskItem> is a repeatable wrapper describing discrete tasks to be taught.
element.title: Task Item

element.name: lcTechnical
element.definition: The element <lcTechnical> is the fifth high level container element under the element <learningPlan>. It describes the technical requirements to the learning content and how those requirements are supported by the instructional design.
element.title: Technical

element.name: lcTime
element.definition: The element <lcTime> specifies the time expected to complete an activity.
element.title: Time

element.name: lcTrueFalse
element.definition: The true-false interaction presents the learner with two choices: one correct, the other incorrect, and is often presented as true/false or yes/no responses.
element.title: True-false

element.name: lcValues
element.definition: The element <lcValues> describes affective components of desired instructional outcomes.
element.title: Values

element.name: lcViewers
element.definition: The element <lcViewers> describes viewers used for time-sequenced display at runtime.
element.title: Viewers

element.name: lcW3C
element.definition: The element <lcW3C> describes standards used for data accessibility and conformity to standards.
element.title: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)

element.name: lcWorkEnv
element.definition: The element <lcWorkEnv> is the third wrapper tag within the element <lcNeedsAnalysis>. It describes the working conditions and contexts in which the training will be applied.
element.title: Work Environment

element.name: lcWorkEnvDescription
element.definition: The element <lcWorkEnvDescription> describes the general working environment in which the training will be applied.
element.title: Work Environment Description

element.name: learning
element.definition: This element is used to contain the five learning information types:
element.title: Learning content

element.name: learningAssessment
element.definition: A Learning Assessment presents questions or interactions that measure progress, encourage recollection, and stimulate reinforcement of the learning content, and can be presented before the content as a pre-assessment or as a post-assessment test. The format of each interactive assessment question can be structured as one of the following question types: true-false, single select, multiple select, sequencing, matching or hotspot. Therefore, one "learning assessment" can contain a series of individual "interactions", each of which contains a "question type". The interactions use a subset of the Question-Test Interoperability (IMS QTI) specification.
element.title: Learning assessment

element.name: learningContent
element.definition: A learning content topic comprises a set of self-contained content about a single terminal learning objective supported by zero or more enabling learning objectives. It provides the learning content itself, and enables direct use of content from the S1000D descript data module. It supports specific objectives declared in the Learning plan topic type.
element.title: Learning content

element.name: learningOverview
element.definition: The learning overview structure covers introductory course information. It identifies the learning objectives, includes other information helpful to the learner, such as prerequisites, duration, intended audience, and can include information and strategies that seek to gain attention and stimulate recall of prior learning.
element.title: Learning overview content

element.name: learningPlan
element.definition: A learning plan topic describes learning needs and goals, instructional design models, task analyses, learning taxonomies, and other information necessary to the lesson planning process. The learning plan structure is contained within the element <learning>.
element.title: Learning plan content

element.name: learningSummary
element.definition: A learning summary recaps and provides context for the achievement or accomplishment of learning objectives, provides guidance to reinforce learning and long-term memory, and can pose questions to enhance encoding and verification of the learning content.
element.title: Learning summary content

element.name: legend
element.definition: The element <legend> contains the legend or explanatory list.
element.title: Legend

element.name: length
element.definition: The length information element <length> contains the length of a wire. It is recommended to specify in the length type attribute wireLengthType, whether the length information gives the design length, the real length of the wire or a critical length.
element.title: Length information

element.name: levelledPara
element.definition: The element <levelledPara> is the equivalent of a headed paragraph and subparagraphs. It can have one or more <levelledPara> elements nested within it. The depth of this structure is unlimited, however, it is recommended to not exceed five levels of depth. It is further recommended that additional levels only be used in a conversion effort, where existing data is authored to such a depth and restructuring of data is not feasible. In these cases, the structure must never exceed eight levels of depth. The project or the organization must decide on the depth of breakdown.The Schema allows for a single occurrence of <levelledPara> under a parent <levelledPara>. The project or organization must decide whether to allow this structure in their descriptive data modules or to insist on a minimum occurrence of two <levelledPara> elements.
element.title: Levelled paragraphs

element.name: limit
element.definition: The element <limit> gives the information required to determine when a task must be performed.
element.title: Limit information

element.name: limitRange
element.definition: The element <limitRange> provides the means to establish that the inspection must be performed between two values.
element.title: Limit range

element.name: limitRangeFrom
element.definition: The element <limitRangeFrom> provides the means to establish the starting limit for a limit range between which the inspection must be performed.
element.title: Limit range start

element.name: limitRangeTo
element.definition: The element <limitRangeTo> provides the means to establish the ending limit for a limit range between which the inspection must be performed.
element.title: Limit range end

element.name: limitType
element.definition: The element <limitType> is used to express the threshold values and units of the time limit.
element.title: Limit type

element.name: listItem
element.definition: This element <listItem> is used to contain the list items themselves. It can contain text, or notes and paragraphs.
element.title: List items

element.name: listItemDefinition
element.definition: The element <listItemDefinition> contains the term to be defined. It can contain text, or one or more paragraphs.
element.title: List item definition

element.name: listItemTerm
element.definition: This element is used to contain the term to be defined.
element.title: List item term

element.name: listOfChoices
element.definition: The element <listOfChoices> contains a selection of multiple (one or more) choices. Each of these is giving a reference to another action, to the final action (in element <isolationProcedureEnd>) or to close-up requirements (element <closeRqmts>).
element.title: Answers - Selection of choice

element.name: localFabricationMaterial
element.definition: This element allows specifying one or several raw part(s) from which the defined part can be manufactured and their dimensions or quantity.
element.title: Raw parts

element.name: locateAndRepair
element.definition: The element <locateAndRepair>/<locateAndRepairLruItem> contains any locating and repairing tasks and information on the faulty LRU.
element.title: Locate and repair/Locate and repair LRU

element.name: locateAndRepairSruItem
element.definition: The element <locateAndRepairSruItem> contains any locating and repairing tasks and information on the faulty SRU.
element.title: Locate and repair SRU

element.name: location
element.definition: This element is used to specify in which zone and/or optionally on which electric panel with coordinates if necessary, the functional item is located.
element.title: Functional item location

element.name: locationRcmd
element.definition: The element <locationRcmd > provides information for each location recommendation
element.title: Location recommendation

element.name: locationRcmdSegment
element.definition: The element <locationRcmdSegment> is used to identify an S2000M location recommendation segment (CES). As specified above, this element is only mandatory for S2000M programs.
element.title: CES data

element.name: logo
element.definition: The element <logo> contains the reference to the manufacturer’s, project’s or sponsor’s logotype.
element.title: Logo

element.name: lom
element.definition: The IEEE LOM is a part of the SCO reference model (SCORM) specification. It defines a set of metadata elements for describing learning content, including element names, definitions, data types, and field lengths. The inclusion of the LOM in the SCORM content package allows learning content developers to add metadata about the learning content references within the SCORM content package.
element.title: Learning Object Model

element.name: lowestAuthorizedLevel
element.definition: The element <lowestAuthorizedLevel> indicates the minimum skill authorized to remove, replace, or use an item. The use of this element will facilitate supplying the bench stock applicable to the maintainer’s skill level without having to go through an entire manual to determine what consumable supplies might be needed. It also alerts the clerk in the supply room of which supplies the maintainer is allowed to acquire for bench stock.
element.title: Lowest authorized maintenance level

element.name: lowestAuthorizedLevelGroup
element.definition: The element <lowestAuthorizedLevelGroup> contains groups the different lowest authorized maintenance levels associated to the supply.
element.title: Lowest authorized maintenance level group

element.name: lru
element.definition: The element <lru> contains name, a shortname and identification of the LRU.
element.title: LRU identification

element.name: lruItem
element.definition: The element <lruItem > contains the information needed to perform the test on the faulty LRU.
element.title: Fault isolation test - LRU

element.name: mainProcedure
element.definition: The element <mainProcedure> contains the detailed procedural steps to be done, properly supported by figures, multimedia, foldouts and tables.
element.title: Main procedure

element.name: maintAllocation
element.definition: The element <maintAllocation> contains information about maintenance allocations. Maintenance allocations capture maintenance functions along with maintenance levels and time associated for each task. It is contained in the element <maintPlanning> (refer to Para 2.2).
element.title: Maintenance allocation

element.name: maintAllocationGroup
element.definition: The element <maintAllocationGroup> is used to group maintenance functional items together.
element.title: Maintenance allocation group

element.name: maintLevel
element.definition: The maintenance level is specified by selecting an enumerated value for the attribute maintLevelCode. The estimated work time can be entered as a data string within the element.
element.title: Maintenance level

element.name: maintLevelGroup
element.definition: This element is used to gather the information about the lowest authorized maintenance level and the associated estimated work time to perform the maintenance. <maintLevel>.
element.title: Maintenance level group

element.name: maintPlanning
element.definition: Maintenance planning information is captured using the Content section of the four types of maintenance schedule data modules. These four types are time limits, which captures information about periodicities and life details for a system; task definitions, which captures the information about individual tasks to be carried out on a system, inspection definitions, which captures groups of maintenance tasks or inspection types, and maintenance allocation, which captures maintenance functions along with maintenance levels and time associated for each task.
element.title: Maintenance planning

element.name: maintQualifier
element.definition: The element <maintQualifier> is used to capture maintenance action qualification such as maintenance function, maintenance level estimated work time, any tools and/or test equipment and any remarks.
element.title: Maintenance qualifier

element.name: manufacturerCode
element.definition: The element <manufacturerCode> contains the manufacturer's code.
element.title: Manufacturer code

element.name: mass
element.definition: The element <mass> contains the mass of a connector.
element.title: Mass

element.name: material
element.definition: The element <material> describes the material of which the part is made.
element.title: Material

element.name: maxDiameter
element.definition: The element <maxDiameter> gives the maximum diameter of a solder sleeve.
element.title: Maximum sleeve diameter

element.name: maxHarnessSize
element.definition: The element <maxHarnessSize> gives the maximum harness size.
element.title: Maximum harness size

element.name: maxMountingPositions
element.definition: The maximum number of mounting positions element <maxMountingPositions> contains the number of mounting positions on a next higher assembly, eg a circuit breaker panel. This element is only used for equipment that has mounting positions for other electrical equipment, eg connectors or circuit breakers.
element.title: Maximum number of mounting positions

element.name: menu
element.definition: Menus are the most popular way of getting information from a user. The process data module dialog menu has some powerful features.
element.title: User menus

element.name: menuChoice
element.definition: The element <menuChoice> represents one possible answer to the prompt question. The text of the answer is marked up by element <prompt>.
element.title: User choices

element.name: message
element.definition: The element <message> provides information from the IETP to the user or additional instructions or details about a parent dialog.
element.title: User message

element.name: messageAlt
element.definition: The element <messageAlt> contains alternative messages one or none of which are applicable in a given situation and will be displayed to the user. Refer to Para 2.3.4.2.
element.title: Alternate message

element.name: middleName
element.definition: The element <middleName> contains the middle name of the individual contact.
element.title: Middle name

element.name: minDiameter
element.definition: The element <minDiameter> gives the minimum diameter of a solder sleeve.
element.title: Minimum sleeve diameter

element.name: minHarnessSize
element.definition: The element <minHarnessSize> gives the minimum harness size.
element.title: Minimum harness size

element.name: minTemperature
element.definition: The elements <minTemperature> and <maxTemperature> give the lower and upper temperature rating boundaries for a harness.
element.title: Harness temperature rating child elements

element.name: modelVersion
element.definition: The element <modelVersion> is used to identify the specific version of the equipment to which the item is fitted in this location.
element.title: Model version

element.name: modification
element.definition: The element <modification> contains the identification of the retrofit order.
element.title: Modification

element.name: modificationTitle
element.definition: The element <modificationTitle> contains the title of the modification.
element.title: Modification title

element.name: multimedia
element.definition: The element <multimedia> is an optional, repeatable element, used for marking up all multimedia content. It is the parent element of multimedia objects
element.title: Multimedia

element.name: multimediaObject
element.definition: The element <multimediaObject> is an optional, repeatable element, used for marking up multimedia objects.
element.title: Multimedia Object

element.name: name
element.definition: The element <name> contains the textual name of the function, circuit breaker, controls and indicators, zone or access point, equipment, product etc.
element.title: Name

element.name: natoStockNumber
element.definition: The element <natoStockNumber> contains the NATO Stock Number (NSN) of the support equipment. Optionally, the complete NSN can be broken into its constituent parts by using its attributes.
element.title: NATO stock number - NSN

element.name: networkAnalysisCode
element.definition: The network analysis code describes the behavior of the wire end in the network connection analysis in relation to other wires via the equipment. It is based on the behavior of the equipment to which the wire end is connected. This element can be used as the basis for the analysis of electrical connections in a system.
element.title: Network analysis code

element.name: nextHigherAssy
element.definition: For wires that are part of a physical or logical assembly, eg a box and/or a panel, the next higher assembly element <nextHigherAssy> can be used to identify this equipment.
element.title: Next higher assembly

element.name: noConds
element.definition: The element <noConds> contains the "marker" for no required actions/conditions. If there are no required actions/conditions for the Procedure then the element <noConds> must be used.
element.title: No conditions

element.name: notationName
element.definition: The element <notationName> contains a specific notation name. Each notation, for which special project rules are given, must be specified and its intended use explained.
element.title: Notation name

element.name: notationRule
element.definition: The element <notationRule> contains a notation more specific than defined by S1000D. The rule that applies must be specified. An example would be when a project or an organization decides to exclude use of a particular notation.
element.title: Notation specific rule

element.name: notationRuleList
element.definition: The element <notationRuleList> contains excluded notations. A project or an organization can decide to exclude one or several of the notations allowable by S1000D. These restrictions are to be included in the BREX data module.
element.title: Notation rules

element.name: note
element.definition: The element <note> contains additional information that can be useful to the user.
element.title: Notes

element.name: notePara
element.definition: The element <notePara> contains the note text.
element.title: Note para

element.name: notIllustrated
element.definition: The element <notIllustrated> is used to indicate that an item has not been illustrated. If an item has not been illustrated this element is populated with a hyphen "-".
element.title: Not illustrated

element.name: numberOfCores
element.definition: The element <numberOfCores> contains the number of cores of the wire material.
element.title: Core

element.name: objectPath
element.definition: The element <objectPath> contains an XPath address defining where the element or attribute occurs in the Schema structure. This must be identified for an element or attribute for which rules are given.
element.title: Object path

element.name: objectUse
element.definition: The element <objectUse> contains a specific description and intended use for each element, attribute, or notation that is recorded in the BREX data module.
element.title: Object use

element.name: objectValue
element.definition: The element <objectValue> contains the description of the intended meaning.
element.title: Object value

element.name: observedFault
element.definition: he element <observedFault> contains information on observed faults but not detected by the computerized maintenance system.
element.title: Observed faults

element.name: optionalPart
element.definition: This element provides one or several optional part(s), ie parts that are strictly equivalent to the defined part.
element.title: Optional part

element.name: optionalSupplierCode
element.definition: This element contains the CAGE/CAGE code of an additional optional supplier for the part.
element.title: Optional supplier code

element.name: orientation
element.definition: The element <orientation> contains orientation/polarization information about a connector. Polarization information is normally given as part of the connector's part number. The polarization code can represent the angle between the main keyway and the other keyways of the connector.
element.title: Orientation

element.name: originator
element.definition: The element <originator> contains the identifier of the originating company or organization responsible for the production of the data module/ publication module. The originator’s code is indicated with the company name, the CAGE code, which is the preferred method, or both. Normally, the originator is defined as the designated design authority of the Product; however, projects must nominate the originators. If a responsible partner company has an enterprise code, then that code must be used.
element.title: Originator

element.name: otherItems
element.definition: This element describes textually which items can be reached from the access point.
element.title: Other items

element.name: outerDiameter
element.definition: The element <outerDiameter> contains the outer diameter information of wire material.
element.title: Outer diameter

element.name: outerJacketColor
element.definition: The element <outerJacketColor> contains the color information of the outer jacket of wire material.
element.title: Outer jacket color

element.name: overLengthPartNumber
element.definition: This element contains the initial over length part number for projects, whose part numbers cannot exceed a given length. In this case, the over length part numbers are shortened and the shortened part number is used all over the documentation.
element.title: Over length part number

element.name: packaging
element.definition: The element <packaging> contains information about the packaging of the supply.
element.title: Packaging

element.name: paraBasic
element.definition: Element <paraBasic> contains a description of the external application or other information that will be displayed to the user.
element.title: Element <paraBasic>

element.name: parameter
element.definition: The element <parameter> is an optional, repeatable element, which has attributes used for passing parameters to objects within the multimedia scene.
element.title: Parameter

element.name: partAndSerialNumber
element.definition: The element <partAndSerialNumber> contains parts and serial numbers.
element.title: Part and serial number

element.name: partIdent
element.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, this element identifies semantically the part as a result of its attributes.
element.title: Part identifier

element.name: partIdentSegment
element.definition: The element <partIdentSegment> is used to identify a S2000M Part Identity Segment (PAS). This element is optional to allow the use of external reference to the parts information data of the technical information repository data module.
element.title: PAS data

element.name: partKeyword
element.definition: This element contains the single word name of the part, as defined for the civil aviation.
element.title: Part keyword

element.name: partLocationSegment
element.definition: The element <partLocationSegment> is used to identify a S2000M Part Location Data Segment (CBS).
element.title: Part location data

element.name: partRef
element.definition: This element is used to markup a part (outside of its specification in the part technical repository) and also allows referring to its position in the part technical repository.
element.title: Part

element.name: partRefGroup
element.definition: This element contains the different types of relationships with other parts.
element.title: Relationships with other parts

element.name: partRepository
element.definition: This element is used to provide a list of parts and their associated properties.
element.title: General

element.name: partSpec
element.definition: This element represents a part. It contains its associated properties.
element.title: Part specification

element.name: person
element.definition: The element <person> contains the skill information on the required personnel for the task when there are requirements to individually specify the personnel.
element.title: Person

element.name: personCategory
element.definition: The element <personCategory> contains the required category level of the person.
element.title: Category

element.name: personnel
element.definition: The element <personnel> contains the information on the required personnel for the task by grouping the personnel by category, skill level and trade/trade code together with the number of personnel of a certain skill (category, skill level, trade).
element.title: Personnel

element.name: personSkill
element.definition: The element <personSkill> contains the required skill level of the person. This represents the skill level that the person must have attained to be able to perform his or her role in the Procedure and is, eg Basic, Intermediate or Advanced.
element.title: Skill level

element.name: phoneNumber
element.definition: The element <phoneNumber> is repeatable and contains contact phone numbers for the business.
element.title: Phone numbers

element.name: physicalSecurityPilferageCode
element.definition: The element <physicalSecurityPilferageCode> is used to indicate the degree of security or pilferage risk associated with the item.
element.title: Physical security/pilferage code

element.name: pm
element.definition: The element <pm> defines the content and structure of a publication.
element.title: Publication module

element.name: pmAddress
element.definition: The element <pmAddress> contains the publication module address information.
element.title: Publication module address

element.name: pmAddressItems
element.definition: The element <pmAddressItems> includes additional information about a publication module.
element.title: Publication module address items

element.name: pmCode
element.definition: The element <pmCode> contains the publication module code. Publication modules produced according to this specification must be given a Publication module code.
element.title: Publication module code

element.name: pmEntry
element.definition: The element <pmEntry>
element.title: Publication module entry

element.name: pmEntryTitle
element.definition: The element <pmEntryTitle> contains the title of the publication entry. The title for the following entries must be given. It can be used for the table of contents.
element.title: Title of the publication module entry

element.name: pmIdent
element.definition: The element <pmIdent> contains the publication module identification information.
element.title: Publication module identification

element.name: pmRef
element.definition: The element <pmRef> contains details of the destination publication module that is referred from some other S1000D context, such as a data module, another publication module etc.
element.title: References to publications

element.name: pmRefAddressItems
element.definition: The element <pmRefAddressItems> contains additional identifying information about the destination publication module.
element.title: Complementary identifying information for a publication module

element.name: pmRefGroup
element.definition: This element contains one or several references to publication modules to which the comment/response relates.
element.title: Publication module reference group

element.name: pmRefIdent
element.definition: The element <pmRefIdent> contains the items forming a unique identification of the destination data module.
element.title: Identification of a referred publication module

element.name: pmStatus
element.definition: The element <pmStatus> contains the publication module status.
element.title: Publication module status information

element.name: pmTitle
element.definition: The element <pmTitle> gives the meaning of the publication and is defined by the project.
element.title: Publication module title

element.name: policyStatement
element.definition: The element <policyStatement> contains the reference to the security policy information.
element.title: Policy reference

element.name: positionOnNextHigherAssy
element.definition: Equipment, which is mounted on a physical assembly, eg a box or a panel, has allocated the identification of the position on the next higher assembly element <positionOnNextHigherAssy>. The position is indicated either by a direct position or by grid coordinates.
element.title: Position on next higher assembly

element.name: postalZipCode
element.definition: The element <postalZipCode> contains the zip code for the business.
element.title: Postal zip code

element.name: postOfficeBox
element.definition: The element <postOfficeBox> contains the post office box of the business defined.
element.title: Post office box

element.name: potentialConnectionsOrder
element.definition: This element is used in the situation when more than one wire is connected to an electrical potential, eg an earth bolt. All these wires must have the same value for the electrical potential block grouping information in the wire connection code. In this case, these wires must have ascending numerical values at the potential connections of the wire connection code, which orders the wire to facilitate graphical presentation.
element.title: Potential connections order

element.name: preferredSparePart
element.definition: This element provides one or several preferred spare part(s), ie parts that are recommended by the data provider.
element.title: Preferred spare parts

element.name: preliminaryRqmts
element.definition: The element <preliminaryRqmts> groups together all information about resources that can be required before the accomplishment of the task.
element.title: Preliminary requirements

element.name: preparationInfo
element.definition: For wires, the content model preparationInfo/finishingInfo defines the child elements <preparationInfo> and <finishingInfo>.
element.title: Content model preparationInfo/finishingInfo

element.name: proceduralStep
element.definition: The element <proceduralStep > contains a step in the procedure. A step can be broken down into substeps by including another element <proceduralStep>, which can itself be broken down further into substeps by including another element <proceduralStep>, and so on following the lower branch in Fig 1. In this way, any depth of substep breakdown can be achieved. However, it is highly discouraged not to exceed five levels of depth. The substep breakdown must never exceed eight levels of depth (for details, refer to Business rules decisions below).
element.title: Procedural step

element.name: proceduralStepAlt
element.definition: The element <proceduralStepAlt> provides the capability to group in one structure several potential steps of data for display. Only one or none will be displayed depending on the applicability assigned to the element <proceduralStep> within the element <proceduralStepAlt>. Refer to Para 2.3.4.2.
element.title: Procedural step alternate

element.name: procedure
element.definition: The element <procedure> contains all information necessary to carry out the task or the main objective of the procedural information.
element.title: Procedure

element.name: process
element.definition: The element <process> is the top level element containing the process flow constructs.
element.title: Process Flow Constructs

element.name: procurementData
element.definition: This element groups the properties to procure the part.
element.title: Procurement data

element.name: product
element.definition: The element <product> identifies an individual product instance.
element.title: Product

element.name: productAttribute
element.definition: The element <productAttribute> is used to declare a single attribute of the Product, such as "serial number" or "model".
element.title: Product attribute

element.name: productAttributeList
element.definition: The element <productAttributeList> contains a list of attributes of the Product. The values for product attributes will typically not change throughout the service life of product instance.
element.title: Product attributes

element.name: productConfiguration
element.definition: The element <productConfiguration> contains a reference to the Product configuration as defined for production in the authority block. Any deviation from that configuration or standard is shown by inserting the modification number.
element.title: Product configuration

element.name: productCrossRefTableRef
element.definition: The element <productCrossRefTableRef> provides a reference to the PCT data module for this project.
element.title: PCT reference

element.name: productionMaintData
element.definition: The element <productionMaintData> contains the basic information required for the planning and preparation of the task.
element.title: Production maintenance data

element.name: productSafety
element.definition: The element <productSafety> contains an indication when a module is transmitting information that affects the safety of the product’s users. The element <productSafety> can be empty or can contain textual information describing the urgency for processing the information in the module and handling of the module when third parties now operate the Product.
element.title: Product safety

element.name: prompt
element.definition: The element <prompt> contains text that is the question or information for the user. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.10.
element.title: User prompts

element.name: province
element.definition: The element <province> contains the province where the business is located.
element.title: Province

element.name: pubMedia
element.definition: The repeatable element <pubMedia> specifies the information about how the media on which the publication is delivered.
element.title: Publication media

element.name: pushButton
element.definition: The element <pushButton> provides a means to supply information for the data field entry(s) thru an external application (eg, diagnostic test, sound, and video) or secondary dialog (eg, advanced features).
element.title: Push button

element.name: qualityAssurance
element.definition: The element <qualityAssurance> contains details of the status of the QA process as required by the project. The data module/ publication module must be identified as either being unverified or verified. This element can contain applicability information to indicate the applicability of the QA information. This applicability information must be a subset of the mandatory applicability settings for the complete data module. This applies equally to the element <qualityAssurance> and all its subelements.
element.title: Quality assurance status

element.name: quantity
element.definition: The element <quantity> provides the capability to identify a portion of a paragraph that corresponds to a numeric value with a special meaning, such as a torque value. The exact meaning of the quantity data can be specified using a set of predefined S1000D values, or extended to support specific project needs.
element.title: Quantity data

element.name: quantityGroup
element.definition: The element <quantityGroup> contains a group of values and tolerances and/or multiple values in the case where multiple units of measure are used (eg 2 h 30 min).
element.title: Quantity group

element.name: quantityPerNextHigherAssy
element.definition: The element <quantityPerNextHigherAssy> is used to store the Quantity per Next higher Assembly (QNA) of an item. If the item is included for reference only the letters "REF" are entered. If the quantity cannot be established or it is otherwise not appropriate to include the data, the letters "AR" (As Required) are entered.
element.title: Quantity per next higher assembly

element.name: quantityTolerance
element.definition: The element <quantityTolerance> contains a decimal tolerance value, the type of tolerance, and an optional unit of measure. The tolerance value must conform to the W3C XML standard for decimal values which reuires use a period [.] for the separator between the integralpart and the fractionalpart, and no thousands separator. The display format is not specified in the XML code, but must conform to program or country requirements at presentation (refer to Chap 3.9.1 for rules on presentation).
element.title: Tolerance

element.name: quantityValue
element.definition: The element <quantityValue> contains a decimal value and an optional unit of measure. The value must conform to the W3C XML standard for decimal values which requires use a period [.] for the separator between the integral part and the fractional part, and no thousands separator. The display format is not specified in the XML code but, must conform to program or country requirements at presentation (Refer to Chap 3.9.1 for rules on presentation).
element.title: Value

element.name: rack
element.definition: The element <rack> contains rack information about rack & panel connectors.
element.title: Rack

element.name: randomList
element.definition: The element <randomList> contains random lists. It can contain applicability information, a title and the list items themselves.
element.title: Random list

element.name: rcmd
element.definition: The element <rcmd> contains the recommendations linked to the supply requirement alternative.
element.title: Recommendation

element.name: rcmdQuantity
element.definition: The element <rcmdQuantity> contains the tool recommended quantity.
element.title: Recommended quantity

element.name: reasonForAmendment
element.definition: If used, the element <reasonForAmendment> must record the reason for amendment of either a complete figure, or of individual illustration sheets of a multi-sheet figure. This is to be used to indicate changes made to the illustration itself, for example, "location view has been added", or "cross-section view has been added for Mod. XYZ".
element.title: Reason for amendment

element.name: reasonForSelection
element.definition: The element <reasonForSelection> is used to store the Reason For Selection (RFS) of an item.
element.title: Reason for selection

element.name: reasonForUpdate
element.definition: The element <reasonForUpdate> contains a short explanation of the reason for updating of the data module/ publication module. For more details, refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1.
element.title: Reason for update

element.name: receiveByName
element.definition: Element <receiveByName> is used when the external application returns data in name/value pairs.
element.title: Receive by name

element.name: receiveByPosition
element.definition: Element <receiveByPosition> is used when the external application returns data in a stream of delimited values by position.
element.title: Receive by position

element.name: receiveValue
element.definition: Element <receiveValue> contains element <variableRef> which is the variable to be assigned the value received from the external application. When the returned values exceed the number of receiveValue definitions, the remaining receiveValue information is discarded.
element.title: Receive value

element.name: referenceDesignator
element.definition: The reference designator is the unique identifier of electrical equipment in the system.
element.title: Reference designator

element.name: referTo
element.definition: The element <referTo> is used to contain a reference to multiple IPP or CSN.
element.title: Refer to

element.name: refs
element.definition: The element <refs> is used to populate the standardized tabular list "Table 1 References". This paragraph gives the rules and recommendations for inclusion of the standardized tabular list "Table 1 References" at the beginning of the data module content section.
element.title: References presented in the reference table of a data module

element.name: relatedTask
element.definition: The attributes of this element identify another task that has an association to the current task and provide a code that indicates the nature of the association.
element.title: Related task

element.name: remarks
element.definition: The element <remarks> can contain general remarks. If there are no remarks then this element need not be used.
element.title: Remarks

element.name: remarksGroup
element.definition: The element <remarksGroup> is used to capture data about the tool or test equipment. It includes elements for tools list code, maintenance, nomenclature, NSN, and tool number.
element.title: Remarks group

element.name: remarksList
element.definition: The element <remarksList> is used to list remarks pertinent to the maintenance functions listed in maintenance allocation data. The purpose is to provide a list for referencing from maintenance allocation. When remarks are indicated in the maintenance allocation, the remarks list must be included.
element.title: Remarks list

element.name: remarksRefs
element.definition: The element <remarksRefs> is used to contain a reference to remarks contained in the remarks list within the maintenance allocation data.
element.title: Remarks References

element.name: repair
element.definition: The element <repair> contains any repair procedure.
element.title: Repair

element.name: replacedBy
element.definition: This element provides a part that can replace the defined part. The kind of replacement is specified by its attribute. It is also possible to associate a textual condition to this replacement relationship. Some replacement relationships can only be applicable to some product instances.
element.title: Replacement relationship

element.name: replacementCond
element.definition: This element is used to specify the condition that has to be fulfilled for the replacement, if any.
element.title: Replacement condition

element.name: reqCond
element.definition: The element <reqCond> contains the required action/condition statement, such as "Open the circuit breaker:" or "Make sure the circuit breaker is open, safetied/locked and tagged:" (which might require a separate Procedure).
element.title: Required condition

element.name: reqCondCircuitBreaker
element.definition: The element <reqCondCircuitBreaker> contains a set of circuit breaker actions (open or close)/conditions (open or closed) before the performance of the task.
element.title: Required conditions - circuit breaker list

element.name: reqCondDm
element.definition: The element <reqCondDm> contains the required action/condition when satisfied by completing a Procedure that is described in a separate data module.
element.title: Required conditions - referenced data module

element.name: reqCondExternalPub
element.definition: The element <reqCondExternalPub> contains the required action/condition when are contained in a non S1000D publication or document.
element.title: Required conditions - referenced non S1000D publication or document

element.name: reqCondGroup
element.definition: This element <reqCondGroup> contains any required conditions information. Required conditions are actions to be done and/or conditions that must be satisfied before the Procedure which is the subject of the data module is started.
element.title: Required conditions

element.name: reqCondNoRef
element.definition: The element <reqCondNoRef> contains the action/condition on its own with no referenced data module or technical publication to represent a simple one step action/condition that does not require further explanation.
element.title: Required condition - simple action/condition

element.name: reqCondPm
element.definition: The element <reqCondPm> contains the required action/condition when they are contained in another publication module.
element.title: Required conditions - referenced publication module

element.name: reqPersons
element.definition: The element <reqPersons> contains the information on the required personnel for the task.
element.title: Required persons

element.name: reqQuantity
element.definition: The element <reqQuantity> contains the number of equipment items that are subject to the time limit in the scope of the Product.
element.title: Required quantity

element.name: reqSafety
element.definition: The element <reqSafety> must contain information to list any safety requirements.
element.title: Required safety

element.name: reqSpares
element.definition: This element <reqSpares> must contain information to list any required spares.
element.title: Required spares

element.name: reqSupplies
element.definition: The element <reqSupplies> contains information to list any required supplies.
element.title: Required supplies

element.name: reqSupportEquips
element.definition: The element <reqSupportEquips> must contain information to list any support equipment including special tools, required to accomplish the Procedure contained in the data module. Common types of test equipment such as voltmeters, signal generators and continuity testers must be listed. Common tools that are part of a standard tool kit must not be listed.
element.title: Required support equipment

element.name: reqTechInfo
element.definition: The element <reqTechInfo> contains the content of <reqTechInfoGroup>.
element.title: Required technical information

element.name: scormContentPackageIdent
element.definition: The SCORM content package identification contains the code that makes up the address for either a full learning event or a single or collection of learning products. The SCORM content package identification is contained within the markup element <scormContentPackageIdent>.identifies the complete aggregation.
element.title: SCORM content package identification

element.name: scormContentPackageMedia
element.definition: This element has mandatory attributes: type and code (label) of the media on which the SCORM content package is delivered. Additional optional attributes are volume and location of the media. This element can be repeated.
element.title: SCORM content package media

element.name: scormContentPackageStatus
element.definition: The SCORM Content Package Status is used to identify the configuration and life cycle status of the learning content product. Information includes applicability, QA checks, and system breakdown numbers.
element.title: SCORM content package status

element.name: scormContentPackageTitle
element.definition: The SCORM content package address title contains the name of the learning product deliverable.
element.title: SCORM content package title

element.name: screen
element.definition: The element <screen> and its attributes contain information of the type of the wire in a shielding situation and the identification of the screen to which the wire end is connected.
element.title: Screen/shield information

element.name: screenCount
element.definition: The element <screenCount> contains the number of screens of the wire material.
element.title: Screen count

element.name: screenGroup
element.definition: The list of screens element <screenGroup> is used as a container for the subordinate screen/shield information elements.
element.title: List of screens

element.name: screenOrder
element.definition: The shielding order element <screenOrder> contains an ascending numerical value, which represents the order of the wires connected to an equipment, for graphical presentation of the shielding situation.
element.title: Shielding order

element.name: secondVerification
element.definition: The element <secondVerification> contains identifies a data module which has been second verified. Data modules cannot be only second verified. They must also be first verified. For details on verification, refer to Chap 3.7.
element.title: Second verification

element.name: sectionIdent
element.definition: Wires which are connected by non-functional breaks such as connectors, terminal junction modules, splices, etc, often get the same wire identification number and different section identifications. In this case, the wire section identification element must be populated with the identifiers for these different sections.
element.title: Wire section identification

element.name: security
element.definition: The element <security> contains the security classification of the complete data module/ publicatio module and its contained or associated illustrations.
element.title: Security classification

element.name: selectOrManufacture
element.definition: The element <selectOrManufacture> is used to identify the range of items to be used for the selection, manufacture, rework or repair of an item. Items should be identified using the CSN, figure number and item number or just item number as appropriate.
element.title: Select or manufacture

element.name: selectOrManufactureFromIdent
element.definition: The element <selectOrManufactureFromIdent> is used to indicate that an item must be selected to suit specific operating conditions, or that the item can be locally manufactured.
element.title: Select or manufacture from identifier

element.name: send
element.definition: Element <send> defines parameters to send to the called application.
element.title: Element <send>

element.name: sequentialList
element.definition: The element <sequentialList> contains sequential lists, which are also known as ordered lists. It can contain applicability information, a title and the list items themselves.
element.title: General

element.name: serialNumber
element.definition: The element <serialNumber> contains the listing of a single serial number or a range.
element.title: Serial number

element.name: service
element.definition: The element <service> is used to identify the user service to which specific data is applicable. The first two characters of this element should be populated with the user nation code. The third character is project specific.
element.title: Service

element.name: shelfLife
element.definition: The element <shelfLife> contains information about the shelf life of the supply.
element.title: Shelf life

element.name: shippingInfo
element.definition: The element <shippingInfo> contains the shipping information for the supply if any. They are divided into fours types of information.
element.title: Shipping information

element.name: shortDescr
element.definition: The element <shortDescr> gives a description of the element which it is contained in.
element.title: Short Description

element.name: shortPmTitle
element.definition: The element <shortPmTitle> contains the short title of the publication and is defined by the project.
element.title: Short publication module title

element.name: shrinkSleeve
element.definition: The element <shrinkSleeve> is contained in the list of shrink sleeves element <shrinkSleeveGroup>. The list of shrink sleeves is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
element.title: Element <shrinkSleeve> and child elements

element.name: shuntGroupingValue
element.definition: This element is only used for equipment with internal logic. It provides grouping information for contacts that belong to the same shunt/bus of a termination module or the same position of a switch or a relay.
element.title: Shunt grouping information

element.name: siblingPlugIdent
element.definition: The element <siblingPlugIdent> contains the reference designator of the mate connector in the subordinate element <referenceDesignator>. That means, the plug gets as twin connector identification the reference designator of the receptacle, and the receptacle gets as twin connector identification the reference designator of the plug.
element.title: Twin connector identification

element.name: signalInfo
